## Mensagem 593 | assistant | 08/26/2026 12:00:16

Perfeito. Ajustei o relatório para ficar no grão correto: uma linha por OS/equipamento, sem repetir a OS por linha de material.

Também removi:

- `Status Cartao Codigo`
- `Status OS Codigo`
- `Numero Serie Interno`

E incluí duas origens de valor/custo por OS:

- Pedido de Transferência de Estoque vinculado pela OS: `OWTQ."U_MM_OS" = OSCL."callID"`
- Pedido de Venda Gerado por OS: `ORDR."U_MM_Tipo" = '4'`, vinculado preferencialmente por `OSCL."U_MM_PV"` e, como apoio, pelo texto “Chamado de Serviço” no pedido.

Segue a query completa:

```sql
WITH OS_BASE AS (
    SELECT
        OS0."callID" AS "NumeroOS",
        OS0."DocNum" AS "DocumentoOS",
        OS0."contractID" AS "NumeroContratoLOC1",
        OS0."createDate" AS "DataCriacaoOS",
        OS0."closeDate" AS "DataFechamentoOS",
        OS0."subject" AS "AssuntoOS",
        OS0."status" AS "StatusOSCodigo",

        CASE
            WHEN OS0."status" = -3 THEN 'Aberto'
            WHEN OS0."status" = -2 THEN 'Pendente'
            WHEN OS0."status" = -1 THEN 'Fechado'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 1 THEN 'Aguardando Pecas'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 2 THEN 'Encerrado IClass'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 3 THEN 'Enviar IClass'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 4 THEN 'Enviado IClass'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 5 THEN 'Equipamento Parado'
            ELSE 'Nao Definido'
        END AS "StatusOS",

        OS0."U_MM_PV" AS "PedidoVendaInformadoOS",
        OS0."U_MM_CC" AS "CentroCustoOS",

        EQ."insID" AS "NumeroCartaoEquipamento",
        EQ."itemCode" AS "CodigoEquipamento",
        EQ."itemName" AS "DescricaoEquipamento",
        EQ."manufSN" AS "SerieFabricante",
        EQ."customer" AS "CodigoCliente",
        EQ."custmrName" AS "NomeCliente",

        CASE
            WHEN EQ."status" = 'A' THEN 'Ativo'
            WHEN EQ."status" = 'T' THEN 'Terminado'
            WHEN EQ."status" = 'R' THEN 'Renovado'
            WHEN EQ."status" = 'L' THEN 'Emprestado'
            ELSE 'Nao Definido'
        END AS "StatusCartao",

        EQ."U_ICL_Horimeter" AS "HorimetroCartao"

    FROM OSCL OS0

    INNER JOIN OINS EQ
        ON EQ."insID" = OS0."insID"

    WHERE
        OS0."insID" IS NOT NULL
),

TRANSF_BASE AS (
    SELECT
        TR0."U_MM_OS" AS "NumeroOS",

        TR0."DocEntry" AS "DocEntryTransferencia",
        TR0."DocNum" AS "PedidoTransferencia",
        TR0."DocDate" AS "DataTransferencia",

        TR1."ItemCode" AS "CodigoMaterial",
        TR1."Dscription" AS "DescricaoMaterial",
        TR1."Quantity" AS "QuantidadeMaterial",
        TR1."LineTotal" AS "ValorMaterialLinha"

    FROM OWTQ TR0

    INNER JOIN WTQ1 TR1
        ON TR1."DocEntry" = TR0."DocEntry"

    WHERE
        TR0."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND TR0."U_MM_OS" IS NOT NULL
),

TRANSF_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        T."NumeroOS",

        STRING_AGG(T."PedidoTransferenciaTexto", ', ') AS "PedidosTransferencia",
        MAX(T."DataTransferencia") AS "UltimaDataTransferencia",

        SUM(T."ValorMaterialLinha") AS "ValorTransferenciaEstoque",

        STRING_AGG(T."MateriaisTexto", ' | ') AS "MateriaisTransferencia"

    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            TB."NumeroOS",
            TO_VARCHAR(TB."PedidoTransferencia") AS "PedidoTransferenciaTexto",
            TB."DataTransferencia",
            TB."ValorMaterialLinha",

            TB."CodigoMaterial"
                || ' - '
                || TB."DescricaoMaterial"
                || ' - Qtd: '
                || TO_VARCHAR(TB."QuantidadeMaterial") AS "MateriaisTexto"

        FROM TRANSF_BASE TB
    ) T

    GROUP BY
        T."NumeroOS"
),

PV_OS_BASE AS (
    SELECT
        OSB."NumeroOS",

        PV."DocEntry" AS "DocEntryPedidoVenda",
        PV."DocNum" AS "PedidoVenda",
        PV."DocDate" AS "DataPedidoVenda",
        PV."DocTotal" AS "ValorPedidoVenda",

        PV."CardCode" AS "CodigoClientePedidoVenda",
        PV."CardName" AS "NomeClientePedidoVenda",

        CASE
            WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '4' THEN 'Gerado por OS (Pre-Consumo)'
            ELSE 'Nao Definido'
        END AS "TipoPedidoVenda"

    FROM OS_BASE OSB

    INNER JOIN ORDR PV
        ON PV."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '4'
        AND (
            PV."DocNum" = OSB."PedidoVendaInformadoOS"

            OR UPPER(IFNULL(PV."NumAtCard", '')) LIKE
                '%' || TO_VARCHAR(OSB."NumeroOS") || '%'

            OR UPPER(IFNULL(PV."Comments", '')) LIKE
                '%' || TO_VARCHAR(OSB."NumeroOS") || '%'
        )
),

PV_OS_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        P."NumeroOS",

        STRING_AGG(P."PedidoVendaTexto", ', ') AS "PedidosVendaGeradosOS",
        MAX(P."DataPedidoVenda") AS "UltimaDataPedidoVenda",

        SUM(P."ValorPedidoVenda") AS "ValorPedidosVendaGeradosOS"

    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            PB."NumeroOS",
            TO_VARCHAR(PB."PedidoVenda") AS "PedidoVendaTexto",
            PB."DataPedidoVenda",
            PB."ValorPedidoVenda"

        FROM PV_OS_BASE PB
    ) P

    GROUP BY
        P."NumeroOS"
),

RELATORIO AS (
    SELECT
        OSB."NumeroContratoLOC1",
        OSB."NumeroCartaoEquipamento",
        OSB."CodigoEquipamento",
        OSB."DescricaoEquipamento",
        OSB."SerieFabricante",
        OSB."CodigoCliente",
        OSB."NomeCliente",
        OSB."StatusCartao",
        OSB."HorimetroCartao",

        OSB."NumeroOS",
        OSB."DocumentoOS",
        OSB."DataCriacaoOS",
        OSB."DataFechamentoOS",
        OSB."AssuntoOS",
        OSB."StatusOS",
        OSB."CentroCustoOS",

        IFNULL(TRF."PedidosTransferencia", '') AS "Pedidos Transferencia",
        TRF."UltimaDataTransferencia" AS "Ultima Data Transferencia",
        IFNULL(TRF."ValorTransferenciaEstoque", 0) AS "Valor Transferencia Estoque",
        IFNULL(TRF."MateriaisTransferencia", '') AS "Materiais Transferencia",

        IFNULL(PVG."PedidosVendaGeradosOS", '') AS "Pedidos Venda Gerados OS",
        PVG."UltimaDataPedidoVenda" AS "Ultima Data Pedido Venda Gerado OS",
        IFNULL(PVG."ValorPedidosVendaGeradosOS", 0) AS "Valor Pedidos Venda Gerados OS",

        (
            IFNULL(TRF."ValorTransferenciaEstoque", 0)
            +
            IFNULL(PVG."ValorPedidosVendaGeradosOS", 0)
        ) AS "Custo Total OS"

    FROM OS_BASE OSB

    LEFT JOIN TRANSF_AGR TRF
        ON TRF."NumeroOS" = OSB."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN PV_OS_AGR PVG
        ON PVG."NumeroOS" = OSB."NumeroOS"
)

SELECT
    R."NumeroContratoLOC1" AS "Numero Contrato LOC1",
    R."NumeroCartaoEquipamento" AS "Numero Cartao Equipamento",
    R."CodigoEquipamento" AS "Codigo Equipamento",
    R."DescricaoEquipamento" AS "Descricao Equipamento",
    R."SerieFabricante" AS "Serie Fabricante",
    R."CodigoCliente" AS "Codigo Cliente",
    R."NomeCliente" AS "Nome Cliente",
    R."StatusCartao" AS "Status Cartao",
    R."HorimetroCartao" AS "Horimetro Cartao",

    R."NumeroOS" AS "Numero OS",
    R."DocumentoOS" AS "Documento OS",
    R."DataCriacaoOS" AS "Data Criacao OS",
    R."DataFechamentoOS" AS "Data Fechamento OS",
    R."AssuntoOS" AS "Assunto OS",
    R."StatusOS" AS "Status OS",
    R."CentroCustoOS" AS "Centro Custo OS",

    R."Pedidos Transferencia",
    R."Ultima Data Transferencia",
    R."Valor Transferencia Estoque",
    R."Materiais Transferencia",

    R."Pedidos Venda Gerados OS",
    R."Ultima Data Pedido Venda Gerado OS",
    R."Valor Pedidos Venda Gerados OS",

    R."Custo Total OS",

    SUM(R."Custo Total OS") OVER (
        PARTITION BY R."NumeroCartaoEquipamento"
    ) AS "Custo Total Vida Equipamento",

    CASE
        WHEN R."Valor Transferencia Estoque" = 0
         AND R."Valor Pedidos Venda Gerados OS" = 0
        THEN 'Sem custo vinculado'

        WHEN R."Valor Transferencia Estoque" > 0
         AND R."Valor Pedidos Venda Gerados OS" > 0
        THEN 'Custo por transferencia e pedido gerado por OS'

        WHEN R."Valor Transferencia Estoque" > 0
        THEN 'Custo por transferencia de estoque'

        WHEN R."Valor Pedidos Venda Gerados OS" > 0
        THEN 'Custo por pedido de venda gerado por OS'

        ELSE 'Validar'
    END AS "Origem Custo OS"

FROM RELATORIO R

ORDER BY
    R."NomeCliente",
    R."CodigoEquipamento",
    R."NumeroCartaoEquipamento",
    R."NumeroOS";
```

Segue a query completa revisada:

```sql
WITH OS_BASE AS (
    SELECT
        OS0."callID" AS "NumeroOS",
        OS0."DocNum" AS "DocumentoOS",
        OS0."contractID" AS "NumeroContratoLOC1",
        OS0."createDate" AS "DataCriacaoOS",

        OS0."subject" AS "AssuntoOS",

        CASE
            WHEN OS0."status" = -3 THEN 'Aberto'

            WHEN OS0."status" = 1 THEN 'Aguardando Pecas'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 2 THEN 'Encerrado IClass'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 3 THEN 'Enviar IClass'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 4 THEN 'Enviado IClass'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 5 THEN 'Equipamento Parado'
            ELSE 'Nao Definido'
        END AS "StatusOS",

        OS0."U_MM_PV" AS "PedidoVendaInformadoOS",

        IFNULL(CCOS."OcrName", OS0."U_MM_CC") AS "CentroCustoOS",

        EQ."insID" AS "NumeroCartaoEquipamento",
        EQ."itemCode" AS "CodigoEquipamento",
        EQ."itemName" AS "DescricaoEquipamento",
        EQ."manufSN" AS "SerieFabricante",
        EQ."customer" AS "CodigoCliente",
        EQ."custmrName" AS "NomeCliente",

        CASE
            WHEN EQ."status" = 'A' THEN 'Ativo'
            WHEN EQ."status" = 'T' THEN 'Terminado'
            WHEN EQ."status" = 'R' THEN 'Renovado'
            WHEN EQ."status" = 'L' THEN 'Emprestado'
            ELSE 'Nao Definido'
        END AS "StatusCartao",

        EQ."U_ICL_Horimeter" AS "HorimetroCartao"

    FROM OSCL OS0

    INNER JOIN OINS EQ
        ON EQ."insID" = OS0."insID"

    LEFT JOIN OOCR CCOS
        ON CCOS."OcrCode" = OS0."U_MM_CC"

    WHERE
        OS0."insID" IS NOT NULL
),

TRANSF_BASE AS (
    SELECT
        TR0."U_MM_OS" AS "NumeroOS",

        TR0."DocEntry" AS "DocEntryTransferencia",
        TR0."DocNum" AS "PedidoTransferencia",
        TR0."DocDate" AS "DataTransferencia",

        TR1."ItemCode" AS "CodigoMaterial",
        TR1."Dscription" AS "DescricaoMaterial",
        TR1."Quantity" AS "QuantidadeMaterial",
        TR1."LineTotal" AS "ValorMaterialLinha"

    FROM OWTQ TR0

    INNER JOIN WTQ1 TR1
        ON TR1."DocEntry" = TR0."DocEntry"

    WHERE
        TR0."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND TR0."U_MM_OS" IS NOT NULL
),

TRANSF_DOC_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        D."NumeroOS",
        STRING_AGG(D."PedidoTransferenciaTexto", ', ') AS "PedidosTransferencia",
        MAX(D."DataTransferencia") AS "UltimaDataTransferencia"

    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            TB."NumeroOS",
            TO_VARCHAR(TB."PedidoTransferencia") AS "PedidoTransferenciaTexto",
            TB."DataTransferencia"

        FROM TRANSF_BASE TB
    ) D

    GROUP BY
        D."NumeroOS"
),

TRANSF_MAT_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        M."NumeroOS",
        SUM(M."ValorMaterialLinha") AS "ValorTransferenciaEstoque",
        STRING_AGG(M."MateriaisTexto", ' | ') AS "MateriaisTransferencia"

    FROM (
        SELECT
            TB."NumeroOS",
            TB."ValorMaterialLinha",

            TB."CodigoMaterial"
                || ' - '
                || TB."DescricaoMaterial"
                || ' - Qtd: '
                || TO_VARCHAR(TB."QuantidadeMaterial") AS "MateriaisTexto"

        FROM TRANSF_BASE TB
    ) M

    GROUP BY
        M."NumeroOS"
),

TRANSF_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        DOC."NumeroOS",
        DOC."PedidosTransferencia",
        DOC."UltimaDataTransferencia",
        IFNULL(MAT."ValorTransferenciaEstoque", 0) AS "ValorTransferenciaEstoque",
        IFNULL(MAT."MateriaisTransferencia", '') AS "MateriaisTransferencia"

    FROM TRANSF_DOC_AGR DOC

    LEFT JOIN TRANSF_MAT_AGR MAT
        ON MAT."NumeroOS" = DOC."NumeroOS"
),

PV_OS_BASE AS (
    SELECT
        OSB."NumeroOS",

        PV."DocEntry" AS "DocEntryPedidoVenda",
        PV."DocNum" AS "PedidoVenda",
        PV."DocDate" AS "DataPedidoVenda",
        PV."DocTotal" AS "ValorPedidoVenda",

        PV."CardCode" AS "CodigoClientePedidoVenda",
        PV."CardName" AS "NomeClientePedidoVenda",

        CASE
            WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '4' THEN 'Gerado por OS (Pre-Consumo)'
            ELSE 'Nao Definido'
        END AS "TipoPedidoVenda"

    FROM OS_BASE OSB

    INNER JOIN ORDR PV
        ON PV."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '4'
        AND (
            PV."DocNum" = OSB."PedidoVendaInformadoOS"

            OR UPPER(IFNULL(PV."NumAtCard", '')) LIKE
                '%' || TO_VARCHAR(OSB."NumeroOS") || '%'

            OR UPPER(IFNULL(PV."Comments", '')) LIKE
                '%' || TO_VARCHAR(OSB."NumeroOS") || '%'
        )
),

PV_OS_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        P."NumeroOS",

        STRING_AGG(P."PedidoVendaTexto", ', ') AS "PedidosVendaGeradosOS",
        MAX(P."DataPedidoVenda") AS "UltimaDataPedidoVenda",

        SUM(P."ValorPedidoVenda") AS "ValorPedidosVendaGeradosOS"

    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            PB."NumeroOS",
            TO_VARCHAR(PB."PedidoVenda") AS "PedidoVendaTexto",
            PB."DataPedidoVenda",
            PB."ValorPedidoVenda"

        FROM PV_OS_BASE PB
    ) P

    GROUP BY
        P."NumeroOS"
),

RELATORIO AS (
    SELECT
        OSB."NumeroContratoLOC1",
        OSB."NumeroCartaoEquipamento",
        OSB."CodigoEquipamento",
        OSB."DescricaoEquipamento",
        OSB."SerieFabricante",
        OSB."CodigoCliente",
        OSB."NomeCliente",
        OSB."StatusCartao",
        OSB."HorimetroCartao",

        OSB."NumeroOS",
        OSB."DocumentoOS",
        OSB."DataCriacaoOS",
        OSB."DataFechamentoOS",
        OSB."AssuntoOS",
        OSB."StatusOS",
        OSB."CentroCustoOS",

        IFNULL(TRF."PedidosTransferencia", '') AS "PedidosTransferencia",
        TRF."UltimaDataTransferencia",
        IFNULL(TRF."ValorTransferenciaEstoque", 0) AS "ValorTransferenciaEstoque",
        IFNULL(TRF."MateriaisTransferencia", '') AS "MateriaisTransferencia",

        IFNULL(PVG."PedidosVendaGeradosOS", '') AS "PedidosVendaGeradosOS",
        PVG."UltimaDataPedidoVenda",
        IFNULL(PVG."ValorPedidosVendaGeradosOS", 0) AS "ValorPedidosVendaGeradosOS",

        (
            IFNULL(TRF."ValorTransferenciaEstoque", 0)
            +
            IFNULL(PVG."ValorPedidosVendaGeradosOS", 0)
        ) AS "CustoTotalOS"

    FROM OS_BASE OSB

    LEFT JOIN TRANSF_AGR TRF
        ON TRF."NumeroOS" = OSB."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN PV_OS_AGR PVG
        ON PVG."NumeroOS" = OSB."NumeroOS"
)

SELECT
    R."NumeroContratoLOC1" AS "Numero Contrato LOC1",
    R."NumeroCartaoEquipamento" AS "Numero Cartao Equipamento",
    R."CodigoEquipamento" AS "Codigo Equipamento",
    R."DescricaoEquipamento" AS "Descricao Equipamento",
    R."SerieFabricante" AS "Serie Fabricante",
    R."CodigoCliente" AS "Codigo Cliente",
    R."NomeCliente" AS "Nome Cliente",
    R."StatusCartao" AS "Status Cartao",
    R."HorimetroCartao" AS "Horimetro Cartao",

    R."NumeroOS" AS "Numero OS",
    R."DocumentoOS" AS "Documento OS",
    R."DataCriacaoOS" AS "Data Criacao OS",
    R."DataFechamentoOS" AS "Data Fechamento OS",
    R."AssuntoOS" AS "Assunto OS",
    R."StatusOS" AS "Status OS",
    R."CentroCustoOS" AS "Centro Custo OS",

    R."PedidosTransferencia" AS "Pedidos Transferencia",
    R."UltimaDataTransferencia" AS "Ultima Data Transferencia",
    R."ValorTransferenciaEstoque" AS "Valor Transferencia Estoque",
    R."MateriaisTransferencia" AS "Materiais Transferencia",

    R."PedidosVendaGeradosOS" AS "Pedidos Venda Gerados OS",
    R."UltimaDataPedidoVenda" AS "Ultima Data Pedido Venda Gerado OS",
    R."ValorPedidosVendaGeradosOS" AS "Valor Pedidos Venda Gerados OS",

    R."CustoTotalOS" AS "Custo Total OS",

    CASE
        WHEN R."ValorTransferenciaEstoque" = 0
         AND R."ValorPedidosVendaGeradosOS" = 0
        THEN 'Sem custo vinculado'

        WHEN R."ValorTransferenciaEstoque" > 0
         AND R."ValorPedidosVendaGeradosOS" > 0
        THEN 'Custo por transferencia e pedido gerado por OS'

        WHEN R."ValorTransferenciaEstoque" > 0
        THEN 'Custo por transferencia de estoque'

        WHEN R."ValorPedidosVendaGeradosOS" > 0
        THEN 'Custo por pedido de venda gerado por OS'

        ELSE 'Validar'
    END AS "Origem Custo OS"

FROM RELATORIO R

ORDER BY
    R."NomeCliente",
    R."CodigoEquipamento",
    R."NumeroCartaoEquipamento",
    R."NumeroOS";
```

- Só usar o texto de observações como apoio quando o padrão for completo, exigindo o parêntese depois do número:

```sql
CHAMADO DE SERVIÇO 4313 (
```

Assim `431` não pega `4313`.

Segue a query completa revisada:

```sql
WITH OS_BASE AS (
    SELECT
        OS0."callID" AS "NumeroOS",
        OS0."DocNum" AS "DocumentoOS",
        OS0."contractID" AS "NumeroContratoLOC1",
        OS0."createDate" AS "DataCriacaoOS",
        OS0."closeDate" AS "DataFechamentoOS",
        OS0."subject" AS "AssuntoOS",

        CASE
            WHEN OS0."status" = -3 THEN 'Aberto'
            WHEN OS0."status" = -2 THEN 'Pendente'
            WHEN OS0."status" = -1 THEN 'Fechado'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 1 THEN 'Aguardando Pecas'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 2 THEN 'Encerrado IClass'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 3 THEN 'Enviar IClass'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 4 THEN 'Enviado IClass'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 5 THEN 'Equipamento Parado'
            ELSE 'Nao Definido'
        END AS "StatusOS",

        OS0."U_MM_PV" AS "PedidoVendaInformadoOS",

        CASE
            WHEN IFNULL(CCOS."OcrName", '') <> ''
            THEN CCOS."OcrName"

            WHEN OS0."U_MM_CC" = '6' THEN 'Gerador'
            WHEN OS0."U_MM_CC" = '7' THEN 'Locacao'
            WHEN OS0."U_MM_CC" = '10' THEN 'Nobreak'
            WHEN OS0."U_MM_CC" = '3' THEN 'Execucao Eletrica'

            WHEN IFNULL(OS0."U_MM_CC", '') = '' THEN ''
            ELSE OS0."U_MM_CC"
        END AS "CentroCustoOS",

        EQ."insID" AS "NumeroCartaoEquipamento",
        EQ."itemCode" AS "CodigoEquipamento",
        EQ."itemName" AS "DescricaoEquipamento",
        EQ."manufSN" AS "SerieFabricante",
        EQ."customer" AS "CodigoCliente",
        EQ."custmrName" AS "NomeCliente",

        CASE
            WHEN EQ."status" = 'A' THEN 'Ativo'
            WHEN EQ."status" = 'T' THEN 'Terminado'
            WHEN EQ."status" = 'R' THEN 'Renovado'
            WHEN EQ."status" = 'L' THEN 'Emprestado'
            ELSE 'Nao Definido'
        END AS "StatusCartao",

        EQ."U_ICL_Horimeter" AS "HorimetroCartao"

    FROM OSCL OS0

    INNER JOIN OINS EQ
        ON EQ."insID" = OS0."insID"

    LEFT JOIN OOCR CCOS
        ON CCOS."OcrCode" = OS0."U_MM_CC"

    WHERE
        OS0."insID" IS NOT NULL
),

TRANSF_BASE AS (
    SELECT
        TR0."U_MM_OS" AS "NumeroOS",
        TR0."DocEntry" AS "DocEntryTransferencia",
        TR0."DocNum" AS "PedidoTransferencia",
        TR0."DocDate" AS "DataTransferencia",

        TR1."ItemCode" AS "CodigoMaterial",
        TR1."Dscription" AS "DescricaoMaterial",
        TR1."Quantity" AS "QuantidadeMaterial",
        TR1."LineTotal" AS "ValorMaterialLinha"

    FROM OWTQ TR0

    INNER JOIN WTQ1 TR1
        ON TR1."DocEntry" = TR0."DocEntry"

    WHERE
        TR0."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND TR0."U_MM_OS" IS NOT NULL
),

TRANSF_DOC_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        D."NumeroOS",
        STRING_AGG(D."PedidoTransferenciaTexto", ', ') AS "PedidosTransferencia",
        MAX(D."DataTransferencia") AS "UltimaDataTransferencia"

    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            TB."NumeroOS",
            TO_VARCHAR(TB."PedidoTransferencia") AS "PedidoTransferenciaTexto",
            TB."DataTransferencia"

        FROM TRANSF_BASE TB
    ) D

    GROUP BY
        D."NumeroOS"
),

TRANSF_MAT_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        M."NumeroOS",
        SUM(M."ValorMaterialLinha") AS "ValorTransferenciaEstoque",
        STRING_AGG(M."MateriaisTexto", ' | ') AS "MateriaisTransferencia"

    FROM (
        SELECT
            TB."NumeroOS",
            TB."ValorMaterialLinha",

            TB."CodigoMaterial"
                || ' - '
                || TB."DescricaoMaterial"
                || ' - Qtd: '
                || TO_VARCHAR(TB."QuantidadeMaterial") AS "MateriaisTexto"

        FROM TRANSF_BASE TB
    ) M

    GROUP BY
        M."NumeroOS"
),

TRANSF_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        DOC."NumeroOS",
        DOC."PedidosTransferencia",
        DOC."UltimaDataTransferencia",
        IFNULL(MAT."ValorTransferenciaEstoque", 0) AS "ValorTransferenciaEstoque",
        IFNULL(MAT."MateriaisTransferencia", '') AS "MateriaisTransferencia"

    FROM TRANSF_DOC_AGR DOC

    LEFT JOIN TRANSF_MAT_AGR MAT
        ON MAT."NumeroOS" = DOC."NumeroOS"
),

PV_OS_BASE AS (
    SELECT
        OSB."NumeroOS",

        PV."DocEntry" AS "DocEntryPedidoVenda",
        PV."DocNum" AS "PedidoVenda",
        PV."DocDate" AS "DataPedidoVenda",
        PV."DocTotal" AS "ValorPedidoVenda",

        PV."CardCode" AS "CodigoClientePedidoVenda",
        PV."CardName" AS "NomeClientePedidoVenda",
        PV."U_LOC1_CallID" AS "ChamadoLOC1Pedido"

    FROM OS_BASE OSB

    INNER JOIN ORDR PV
        ON PV."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '4'
        AND (
            PV."U_LOC1_CallID" = OSB."NumeroOS"

            OR PV."DocNum" = OSB."PedidoVendaInformadoOS"

            OR UPPER(IFNULL(PV."Comments", '')) =
                'CHAMADO DE SERVIÇO ' || TO_VARCHAR(OSB."NumeroOS")

            OR UPPER(IFNULL(PV."Comments", '')) =
                'CHAMADO DE SERVICO ' || TO_VARCHAR(OSB."NumeroOS")

            OR UPPER(IFNULL(PV."Comments", '')) LIKE
                'CHAMADO DE SERVIÇO ' || TO_VARCHAR(OSB."NumeroOS") || ' (%'

            OR UPPER(IFNULL(PV."Comments", '')) LIKE
                'CHAMADO DE SERVICO ' || TO_VARCHAR(OSB."NumeroOS") || ' (%'
        )
),

PV_OS_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        P."NumeroOS",
        STRING_AGG(P."PedidoVendaTexto", ', ') AS "PedidosVendaGeradosOS",
        MAX(P."DataPedidoVenda") AS "UltimaDataPedidoVenda",
        SUM(P."ValorPedidoVenda") AS "ValorPedidosVendaGeradosOS"

    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            PB."NumeroOS",
            TO_VARCHAR(PB."PedidoVenda") AS "PedidoVendaTexto",
            PB."DataPedidoVenda",
            PB."ValorPedidoVenda"

        FROM PV_OS_BASE PB
    ) P

    GROUP BY
        P."NumeroOS"
),

RELATORIO AS (
    SELECT
        OSB."NumeroContratoLOC1",
        OSB."NumeroCartaoEquipamento",
        OSB."CodigoEquipamento",
        OSB."DescricaoEquipamento",
        OSB."SerieFabricante",
        OSB."CodigoCliente",
        OSB."NomeCliente",
        OSB."StatusCartao",
        OSB."HorimetroCartao",

        OSB."NumeroOS",
        OSB."DocumentoOS",
        OSB."DataCriacaoOS",
        OSB."DataFechamentoOS",
        OSB."AssuntoOS",
        OSB."StatusOS",
        OSB."CentroCustoOS",

        IFNULL(TRF."PedidosTransferencia", '') AS "PedidosTransferencia",
        TRF."UltimaDataTransferencia",
        IFNULL(TRF."ValorTransferenciaEstoque", 0) AS "ValorTransferenciaEstoque",
        IFNULL(TRF."MateriaisTransferencia", '') AS "MateriaisTransferencia",

        IFNULL(PVG."PedidosVendaGeradosOS", '') AS "PedidosVendaGeradosOS",
        PVG."UltimaDataPedidoVenda",
        IFNULL(PVG."ValorPedidosVendaGeradosOS", 0) AS "ValorPedidosVendaGeradosOS",

        (
            IFNULL(TRF."ValorTransferenciaEstoque", 0)
            +
            IFNULL(PVG."ValorPedidosVendaGeradosOS", 0)
        ) AS "CustoTotalOS"

    FROM OS_BASE OSB

    LEFT JOIN TRANSF_AGR TRF
        ON TRF."NumeroOS" = OSB."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN PV_OS_AGR PVG
        ON PVG."NumeroOS" = OSB."NumeroOS"
)

SELECT
    R."NumeroContratoLOC1" AS "Numero Contrato LOC1",
    R."NumeroCartaoEquipamento" AS "Numero Cartao Equipamento",
    R."CodigoEquipamento" AS "Codigo Equipamento",
    R."DescricaoEquipamento" AS "Descricao Equipamento",
    R."SerieFabricante" AS "Serie Fabricante",
    R."CodigoCliente" AS "Codigo Cliente",
    R."NomeCliente" AS "Nome Cliente",
    R."StatusCartao" AS "Status Cartao",
    R."HorimetroCartao" AS "Horimetro Cartao",

    R."NumeroOS" AS "Numero OS",
    R."DocumentoOS" AS "Documento OS",
    R."DataCriacaoOS" AS "Data Criacao OS",
    R."DataFechamentoOS" AS "Data Fechamento OS",
    R."AssuntoOS" AS "Assunto OS",
    R."StatusOS" AS "Status OS",
    R."CentroCustoOS" AS "Centro Custo OS",

    R."PedidosTransferencia" AS "Pedidos Transferencia",
    R."UltimaDataTransferencia" AS "Ultima Data Transferencia",
    R."ValorTransferenciaEstoque" AS "Valor Transferencia Estoque",
    R."MateriaisTransferencia" AS "Materiais Transferencia",

    R."PedidosVendaGeradosOS" AS "Pedidos Venda Gerados OS",
    R."UltimaDataPedidoVenda" AS "Ultima Data Pedido Venda Gerado OS",
    R."ValorPedidosVendaGeradosOS" AS "Valor Pedidos Venda Gerados OS",

    R."CustoTotalOS" AS "Custo Total OS",

    CASE
        WHEN R."ValorTransferenciaEstoque" = 0
         AND R."ValorPedidosVendaGeradosOS" = 0
        THEN 'Sem custo vinculado'

        WHEN R."ValorTransferenciaEstoque" > 0
         AND R."ValorPedidosVendaGeradosOS" > 0
        THEN 'Custo por transferencia e pedido gerado por OS'

        WHEN R."ValorTransferenciaEstoque" > 0
        THEN 'Custo por transferencia de estoque'

        WHEN R."ValorPedidosVendaGeradosOS" > 0
        THEN 'Custo por pedido de venda gerado por OS'

        ELSE 'Validar'
    END AS "Origem Custo OS"

FROM RELATORIO R

ORDER BY
    R."NomeCliente",
    R."CodigoEquipamento",
    R."NumeroCartaoEquipamento",
    R."NumeroOS";
```

        PVG."PedidoVendaGeradoOS",

            +

        ) AS "CustoTotalOS"

    FROM OS_BASE OSB

    LEFT JOIN TRANSF_AGR TRF
        ON TRF."NumeroOS" = OSB."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN PV_OS_UNICO PVG
        ON PVG."NumeroOS" = OSB."NumeroOS"
)

SELECT
    R."NumeroContratoLOC1" AS "Numero Contrato LOC1",
    R."NumeroCartaoEquipamento" AS "Numero Cartao Equipamento",
    R."CodigoEquipamento" AS "Codigo Equipamento",

    R."SerieFabricante" AS "Serie Fabricante",

## Mensagem 611 | assistant | 08/26/2026 13:11:43

Sim, agora o diagnóstico ficou claro:

- A coluna `Assunto OS` está larga porque o SAP usa o tamanho do campo retornado. Vamos limitar com `CAST(... AS NVARCHAR(120))`.
- Os pedidos de transferência `669`, `670`, `671` e `676` não aparecem porque eles estão vinculados à OS, mas aparentemente a OS não está necessariamente vinculada ao cartão do equipamento via `OSCL."insID"`.
- Pelo print, o equipamento aparece no pedido de transferência em `Observações Interna`, no padrão `tag T0000547`. Então incluí um vínculo alternativo: quando a OS/cartão não trouxer o equipamento, a query tenta localizar o equipamento pelo `ItemCode` dentro da observação interna da transferência.
- Mantive Pedido de Transferência como 1:N para OS.
- Mantive Pedido de Venda Gerado por OS como 1:1.

Segue a query completa revisada:

```sql
WITH TRANSF_HEADER AS (
    SELECT
        TR0."DocEntry" AS "DocEntryTransferencia",
        TR0."DocNum" AS "PedidoTransferencia",
        TR0."DocDate" AS "DataTransferencia",
        TR0."U_MM_OS" AS "NumeroOS",

        CAST(
            SUBSTRING(TR0."U_MM_OBS_INTERNO", 1, 5000)
            AS NVARCHAR(5000)
        ) AS "ObservacaoInternaTransferencia"

    FROM OWTQ TR0

    WHERE
        TR0."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND TR0."U_MM_OS" IS NOT NULL
),

OS_NUMEROS AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        OS0."callID" AS "NumeroOS"
    FROM OSCL OS0
    WHERE
        OS0."insID" IS NOT NULL

    UNION

    SELECT DISTINCT
        TH."NumeroOS"
    FROM TRANSF_HEADER TH

    UNION

    SELECT DISTINCT
        PV."U_LOC1_CallID" AS "NumeroOS"
    FROM ORDR PV
    WHERE
        PV."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '4'
        AND PV."U_LOC1_CallID" IS NOT NULL
),

OS_BASE AS (
    SELECT
        O."NumeroOS",

        OS0."DocNum" AS "DocumentoOS",
        OS0."contractID" AS "NumeroContratoLOC1",
        OS0."createDate" AS "DataCriacaoOS",
        OS0."closeDate" AS "DataFechamentoOS",
        OS0."subject" AS "AssuntoOS",

        CASE
            WHEN OS0."status" = -3 THEN 'Aberto'
            WHEN OS0."status" = -2 THEN 'Pendente'
            WHEN OS0."status" = -1 THEN 'Fechado'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 1 THEN 'Aguardando Pecas'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 2 THEN 'Encerrado IClass'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 3 THEN 'Enviar IClass'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 4 THEN 'Enviado IClass'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 5 THEN 'Equipamento Parado'
            WHEN OS0."status" IS NULL THEN ''
            ELSE 'Nao Definido'
        END AS "StatusOS",

        CASE
            WHEN IFNULL(CCOS."OcrName", '') <> ''
            THEN CCOS."OcrName"

            WHEN OS0."U_MM_CC" = '6' THEN 'Gerador'
            WHEN OS0."U_MM_CC" = '7' THEN 'Locacao'
            WHEN OS0."U_MM_CC" = '10' THEN 'Nobreak'
            WHEN OS0."U_MM_CC" = '3' THEN 'Execucao Eletrica'

            WHEN IFNULL(OS0."U_MM_CC", '') = '' THEN ''
            ELSE OS0."U_MM_CC"
        END AS "CentroCustoOS",

        EQ."insID" AS "NumeroCartaoEquipamento",
        EQ."itemCode" AS "CodigoEquipamento",
        EQ."itemName" AS "DescricaoEquipamento",
        EQ."manufSN" AS "SerieFabricante",
        EQ."customer" AS "CodigoCliente",
        EQ."custmrName" AS "NomeCliente",

        CASE
            WHEN EQ."status" = 'A' THEN 'Ativo'
            WHEN EQ."status" = 'T' THEN 'Terminado'
            WHEN EQ."status" = 'R' THEN 'Renovado'
            WHEN EQ."status" = 'L' THEN 'Emprestado'
            WHEN EQ."status" IS NULL THEN ''
            ELSE 'Nao Definido'
        END AS "StatusCartao",

        EQ."U_ICL_Horimeter" AS "HorimetroCartao"

    FROM OS_NUMEROS O

    LEFT JOIN OSCL OS0
        ON OS0."callID" = O."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN OINS EQ
        ON EQ."insID" = OS0."insID"

    LEFT JOIN OOCR CCOS
        ON CCOS."OcrCode" = OS0."U_MM_CC"
),

TRANSF_BASE AS (
    SELECT
        TH."NumeroOS",
        TH."DocEntryTransferencia",
        TH."PedidoTransferencia",
        TH."DataTransferencia",
        TH."ObservacaoInternaTransferencia",

        TR1."ItemCode" AS "CodigoMaterial",
        TR1."Dscription" AS "DescricaoMaterial",
        TR1."Quantity" AS "QuantidadeMaterial",
        TR1."LineTotal" AS "ValorMaterialLinha",

        IFNULL(CCTR."OcrName", TR1."OcrCode") AS "CentroCustoTransferencia"

    FROM TRANSF_HEADER TH

    INNER JOIN WTQ1 TR1
        ON TR1."DocEntry" = TH."DocEntryTransferencia"

    LEFT JOIN OOCR CCTR
        ON CCTR."OcrCode" = TR1."OcrCode"
),

TRANSF_DOC_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        D."NumeroOS",
        STRING_AGG(D."PedidoTransferenciaTexto", ', ') AS "PedidosTransferencia",
        MAX(D."DataTransferencia") AS "UltimaDataTransferencia"

    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            TH."NumeroOS",
            TO_VARCHAR(TH."PedidoTransferencia") AS "PedidoTransferenciaTexto",
            TH."DataTransferencia"

        FROM TRANSF_HEADER TH
    ) D

    GROUP BY
        D."NumeroOS"
),

TRANSF_MAT_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        M."NumeroOS",
        SUM(M."ValorMaterialLinha") AS "ValorTransferenciaEstoque",
        STRING_AGG(M."MateriaisTexto", ' | ') AS "MateriaisTransferencia"

    FROM (
        SELECT
            TB."NumeroOS",
            TB."ValorMaterialLinha",

            TB."CodigoMaterial"
                || ' - '
                || TB."DescricaoMaterial"
                || ' - Qtd: '
                || TO_VARCHAR(TB."QuantidadeMaterial") AS "MateriaisTexto"

        FROM TRANSF_BASE TB
    ) M

    GROUP BY
        M."NumeroOS"
),

TRANSF_CC_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        C."NumeroOS",
        STRING_AGG(C."CentroCustoTransferencia", ', ') AS "CentroCustoTransferencia"

    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            TB."NumeroOS",
            TB."CentroCustoTransferencia"

        FROM TRANSF_BASE TB

        WHERE
            IFNULL(TB."CentroCustoTransferencia", '') <> ''
    ) C

    GROUP BY
        C."NumeroOS"
),

TRANSF_EQ_CAND AS (
    SELECT
        TH."NumeroOS",

        EQT."insID" AS "NumeroCartaoEquipamento",
        EQT."itemCode" AS "CodigoEquipamento",
        EQT."itemName" AS "DescricaoEquipamento",
        EQT."manufSN" AS "SerieFabricante",
        EQT."customer" AS "CodigoCliente",
        EQT."custmrName" AS "NomeCliente",

        CASE
            WHEN EQT."status" = 'A' THEN 'Ativo'
            WHEN EQT."status" = 'T' THEN 'Terminado'
            WHEN EQT."status" = 'R' THEN 'Renovado'
            WHEN EQT."status" = 'L' THEN 'Emprestado'
            WHEN EQT."status" IS NULL THEN ''
            ELSE 'Nao Definido'
        END AS "StatusCartao",

        EQT."U_ICL_Horimeter" AS "HorimetroCartao",

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY TH."NumeroOS"
            ORDER BY
                EQT."insID"
        ) AS "LinhaControle"

    FROM TRANSF_HEADER TH

    INNER JOIN OINS EQT
        ON EQT."itemCode" LIKE 'T%'
        AND UPPER(IFNULL(TH."ObservacaoInternaTransferencia", '')) LIKE
            '%' || UPPER(EQT."itemCode") || '%'
),

TRANSF_EQ_UNICO AS (
    SELECT
        E."NumeroOS",
        E."NumeroCartaoEquipamento",
        E."CodigoEquipamento",
        E."DescricaoEquipamento",
        E."SerieFabricante",
        E."CodigoCliente",
        E."NomeCliente",
        E."StatusCartao",
        E."HorimetroCartao"

    FROM TRANSF_EQ_CAND E

    WHERE
        E."LinhaControle" = 1
),

TRANSF_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        DOC."NumeroOS",
        DOC."PedidosTransferencia",
        DOC."UltimaDataTransferencia",
        IFNULL(MAT."ValorTransferenciaEstoque", 0) AS "ValorTransferenciaEstoque",
        IFNULL(MAT."MateriaisTransferencia", '') AS "MateriaisTransferencia",
        IFNULL(CC."CentroCustoTransferencia", '') AS "CentroCustoTransferencia"

    FROM TRANSF_DOC_AGR DOC

    LEFT JOIN TRANSF_MAT_AGR MAT
        ON MAT."NumeroOS" = DOC."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN TRANSF_CC_AGR CC
        ON CC."NumeroOS" = DOC."NumeroOS"
),

PV_OS_CANDIDATOS AS (
    SELECT
        OSB."NumeroOS",

        PV."DocEntry" AS "DocEntryPedidoVenda",
        PV."DocNum" AS "PedidoVenda",
        PV."DocDate" AS "DataPedidoVenda",
        PV."DocTotal" AS "ValorPedidoVenda",

        CASE
            WHEN PV."U_LOC1_CallID" = OSB."NumeroOS"
            THEN 1
            ELSE 2
        END AS "PrioridadeVinculo"

    FROM OS_BASE OSB

    INNER JOIN ORDR PV
        ON PV."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '4'
        AND (
            PV."U_LOC1_CallID" = OSB."NumeroOS"

            OR UPPER(IFNULL(PV."Comments", '')) LIKE
                '%CHAMADO DE SERVIÇO ' || TO_VARCHAR(OSB."NumeroOS") || ' (%'

            OR UPPER(IFNULL(PV."Comments", '')) LIKE
                '%CHAMADO DE SERVICO ' || TO_VARCHAR(OSB."NumeroOS") || ' (%'
        )
),

PV_OS_RANK AS (
    SELECT
        P."NumeroOS",
        P."DocEntryPedidoVenda",
        P."PedidoVenda",
        P."DataPedidoVenda",
        P."ValorPedidoVenda",

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY P."NumeroOS"
            ORDER BY
                P."PrioridadeVinculo",
                P."DataPedidoVenda" DESC,
                P."PedidoVenda" DESC
        ) AS "LinhaControle"

    FROM PV_OS_CANDIDATOS P
),

PV_OS_UNICO AS (
    SELECT
        P."NumeroOS",
        P."PedidoVenda" AS "PedidoVendaGeradoOS",
        P."DataPedidoVenda" AS "DataPedidoVendaGeradoOS",
        P."ValorPedidoVenda" AS "ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS"

    FROM PV_OS_RANK P

    WHERE
        P."LinhaControle" = 1
),

RELATORIO AS (
    SELECT
        OSB."NumeroContratoLOC1",

        IFNULL(OSB."NumeroCartaoEquipamento", TEQ."NumeroCartaoEquipamento") AS "NumeroCartaoEquipamento",
        IFNULL(OSB."CodigoEquipamento", TEQ."CodigoEquipamento") AS "CodigoEquipamento",
        IFNULL(OSB."DescricaoEquipamento", TEQ."DescricaoEquipamento") AS "DescricaoEquipamento",
        IFNULL(OSB."SerieFabricante", TEQ."SerieFabricante") AS "SerieFabricante",
        IFNULL(OSB."CodigoCliente", TEQ."CodigoCliente") AS "CodigoCliente",
        IFNULL(OSB."NomeCliente", TEQ."NomeCliente") AS "NomeCliente",
        IFNULL(OSB."StatusCartao", TEQ."StatusCartao") AS "StatusCartao",
        IFNULL(OSB."HorimetroCartao", TEQ."HorimetroCartao") AS "HorimetroCartao",

        OSB."NumeroOS",
        OSB."DocumentoOS",
        OSB."DataCriacaoOS",
        OSB."DataFechamentoOS",

        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN LENGTH(IFNULL(OSB."AssuntoOS", '')) > 120
                THEN SUBSTRING(OSB."AssuntoOS", 1, 120) || '...'
                ELSE IFNULL(OSB."AssuntoOS", '')
            END
            AS NVARCHAR(123)
        ) AS "AssuntoOS",

        OSB."StatusOS",

        CASE
            WHEN IFNULL(OSB."CentroCustoOS", '') <> ''
            THEN OSB."CentroCustoOS"

            WHEN IFNULL(TRF."CentroCustoTransferencia", '') <> ''
            THEN TRF."CentroCustoTransferencia"

            ELSE ''
        END AS "CentroCustoOS",

        IFNULL(TRF."PedidosTransferencia", '') AS "PedidosTransferencia",
        TRF."UltimaDataTransferencia",
        IFNULL(TRF."ValorTransferenciaEstoque", 0) AS "ValorTransferenciaEstoque",
        IFNULL(TRF."MateriaisTransferencia", '') AS "MateriaisTransferencia",

        PVG."PedidoVendaGeradoOS",
        PVG."DataPedidoVendaGeradoOS",
        IFNULL(PVG."ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS", 0) AS "ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS",

        (
            IFNULL(TRF."ValorTransferenciaEstoque", 0)
            +
            IFNULL(PVG."ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS", 0)
        ) AS "CustoTotalOS"

    FROM OS_BASE OSB

    LEFT JOIN TRANSF_AGR TRF
        ON TRF."NumeroOS" = OSB."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN TRANSF_EQ_UNICO TEQ
        ON TEQ."NumeroOS" = OSB."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN PV_OS_UNICO PVG
        ON PVG."NumeroOS" = OSB."NumeroOS"
)

SELECT
    R."NumeroContratoLOC1" AS "Numero Contrato LOC1",
    R."NumeroCartaoEquipamento" AS "Numero Cartao Equipamento",
    R."CodigoEquipamento" AS "Codigo Equipamento",
    R."DescricaoEquipamento" AS "Descricao Equipamento",
    R."SerieFabricante" AS "Serie Fabricante",
    R."CodigoCliente" AS "Codigo Cliente",
    R."NomeCliente" AS "Nome Cliente",
    R."StatusCartao" AS "Status Cartao",
    R."HorimetroCartao" AS "Horimetro Cartao",

    R."NumeroOS" AS "Numero OS",
    R."DocumentoOS" AS "Documento OS",
    R."DataCriacaoOS" AS "Data Criacao OS",
    R."DataFechamentoOS" AS "Data Fechamento OS",
    R."AssuntoOS" AS "Assunto OS",
    R."StatusOS" AS "Status OS",
    R."CentroCustoOS" AS "Centro Custo OS",

    R."PedidosTransferencia" AS "Pedidos Transferencia",
    R."UltimaDataTransferencia" AS "Ultima Data Transferencia",
    R."ValorTransferenciaEstoque" AS "Valor Transferencia Estoque",
    R."MateriaisTransferencia" AS "Materiais Transferencia",

    R."PedidoVendaGeradoOS" AS "Pedido Venda Gerado OS",
    R."DataPedidoVendaGeradoOS" AS "Data Pedido Venda Gerado OS",
    R."ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS" AS "Valor Pedido Venda Gerado OS",

    R."CustoTotalOS" AS "Custo Total OS",

    CASE
        WHEN R."ValorTransferenciaEstoque" = 0
         AND R."ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS" = 0
        THEN 'Sem custo vinculado'

        WHEN R."ValorTransferenciaEstoque" > 0
         AND R."ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS" > 0
        THEN 'Custo por transferencia e pedido gerado por OS'

        WHEN R."ValorTransferenciaEstoque" > 0
        THEN 'Custo por transferencia de estoque'

        WHEN R."ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS" > 0
        THEN 'Custo por pedido de venda gerado por OS'

        ELSE 'Validar'
    END AS "Origem Custo OS"

FROM RELATORIO R

ORDER BY
    R."NomeCliente",
    R."CodigoEquipamento",
    R."NumeroCartaoEquipamento",
    R."NumeroOS";
```

## Mensagem 615 | assistant | 08/26/2026 13:22:44

Exato. A OS `4313` não preencheu código/nome do cliente porque a query estava pegando cliente apenas do cartão de equipamento (`OINS`). Quando a OS não tem `insID` bem amarrado ao cartão, esses campos ficam vazios.

A correção é usar fallback nesta ordem:

1. Cartão do equipamento (`OINS`)
2. Própria OS (`OSCL`)
3. Pedido de transferência (`OWTQ`)
4. Pedido de venda gerado por OS (`ORDR`)

Segue a query completa revisada com essa correção:

```sql
WITH TRANSF_HEADER AS (

        TR0."DocEntry" AS "DocEntryTransferencia",

        TH."NumeroOS"

    SELECT DISTINCT
        PV."U_LOC1_CallID" AS "NumeroOS"
    FROM ORDR PV
    WHERE
        PV."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '4'
        AND PV."U_LOC1_CallID" IS NOT NULL
),

OS_BASE AS (
    SELECT
        O."NumeroOS",

        OS0."DocNum" AS "DocumentoOS",
        OS0."contractID" AS "NumeroContratoLOC1",
        OS0."createDate" AS "DataCriacaoOS",
        OS0."closeDate" AS "DataFechamentoOS",
        OS0."subject" AS "AssuntoOS",

        CASE
            WHEN OS0."status" = -3 THEN 'Aberto'
            WHEN OS0."status" = -2 THEN 'Pendente'
            WHEN OS0."status" = -1 THEN 'Fechado'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 1 THEN 'Aguardando Pecas'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 2 THEN 'Encerrado IClass'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 3 THEN 'Enviar IClass'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 4 THEN 'Enviado IClass'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 5 THEN 'Equipamento Parado'
            WHEN OS0."status" IS NULL THEN ''
            ELSE 'Nao Definido'
        END AS "StatusOS",

        CASE
            WHEN IFNULL(CCOS."OcrName", '') <> ''
            THEN CCOS."OcrName"
            WHEN OS0."U_MM_CC" = '6' THEN 'Gerador'
            WHEN OS0."U_MM_CC" = '7' THEN 'Locacao'
            WHEN OS0."U_MM_CC" = '10' THEN 'Nobreak'
            WHEN OS0."U_MM_CC" = '3' THEN 'Execucao Eletrica'
            WHEN IFNULL(OS0."U_MM_CC", '') = '' THEN ''
            ELSE OS0."U_MM_CC"
        END AS "CentroCustoOS",

        EQ."insID" AS "NumeroCartaoEquipamento",

        IFNULL(EQ."itemCode", OS0."itemCode") AS "CodigoEquipamento",
        IFNULL(EQ."itemName", OS0."itemName") AS "DescricaoEquipamento",
        IFNULL(EQ."manufSN", OS0."manufSN") AS "SerieFabricante",

        IFNULL(EQ."customer", OS0."customer") AS "CodigoCliente",
        IFNULL(EQ."custmrName", OS0."custmrName") AS "NomeCliente",

        CASE
            WHEN EQ."status" = 'A' THEN 'Ativo'
            WHEN EQ."status" = 'T' THEN 'Terminado'
            WHEN EQ."status" = 'R' THEN 'Renovado'
            WHEN EQ."status" = 'L' THEN 'Emprestado'
            WHEN EQ."status" IS NULL THEN ''
            ELSE 'Nao Definido'
        END AS "StatusCartao",

        EQ."U_ICL_Horimeter" AS "HorimetroCartao"

    FROM OS_NUMEROS O

    LEFT JOIN OSCL OS0
        ON OS0."callID" = O."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN OINS EQ
        ON EQ."insID" = OS0."insID"

    LEFT JOIN OOCR CCOS
        ON CCOS."OcrCode" = OS0."U_MM_CC"
),

TRANSF_BASE AS (
    SELECT
        TH."NumeroOS",
        TH."DocEntryTransferencia",
        TH."PedidoTransferencia",
        TH."DataTransferencia",
        TH."CodigoClienteTransferencia",
        TH."NomeClienteTransferencia",
        TH."ObservacaoInternaTransferencia",

        TR1."ItemCode" AS "CodigoMaterial",
        TR1."Dscription" AS "DescricaoMaterial",
        TR1."Quantity" AS "QuantidadeMaterial",
        TR1."LineTotal" AS "ValorMaterialLinha",

        IFNULL(CCTR."OcrName", TR1."OcrCode") AS "CentroCustoTransferencia"

    FROM TRANSF_HEADER TH

    INNER JOIN WTQ1 TR1
        ON TR1."DocEntry" = TH."DocEntryTransferencia"

    LEFT JOIN OOCR CCTR
        ON CCTR."OcrCode" = TR1."OcrCode"
),

TRANSF_DOC_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        D."NumeroOS",
        STRING_AGG(D."PedidoTransferenciaTexto", ', ') AS "PedidosTransferencia",
        MAX(D."DataTransferencia") AS "UltimaDataTransferencia"

    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            TH."NumeroOS",
            TO_VARCHAR(TH."PedidoTransferencia") AS "PedidoTransferenciaTexto",
            TH."DataTransferencia"

        FROM TRANSF_HEADER TH
    ) D

    GROUP BY
        D."NumeroOS"
),

TRANSF_CLIENTE_RANK AS (
    SELECT
        TH."NumeroOS",
        TH."CodigoClienteTransferencia",
        TH."NomeClienteTransferencia",

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY TH."NumeroOS"
            ORDER BY
                TH."DataTransferencia" DESC,
                TH."PedidoTransferencia" DESC
        ) AS "LinhaControle"

    FROM TRANSF_HEADER TH
),

TRANSF_CLIENTE_UNICO AS (
    SELECT
        T."NumeroOS",
        T."CodigoClienteTransferencia",
        T."NomeClienteTransferencia"

    FROM TRANSF_CLIENTE_RANK T

    WHERE
        T."LinhaControle" = 1
),

TRANSF_MAT_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        M."NumeroOS",
        SUM(M."ValorMaterialLinha") AS "ValorTransferenciaEstoque",
        STRING_AGG(M."MateriaisTexto", ' | ') AS "MateriaisTransferencia"

    FROM (
        SELECT
            TB."NumeroOS",
            TB."ValorMaterialLinha",

            TB."CodigoMaterial"
                || ' - '
                || TB."DescricaoMaterial"
                || ' - Qtd: '
                || TO_VARCHAR(TB."QuantidadeMaterial") AS "MateriaisTexto"

        FROM TRANSF_BASE TB
    ) M

    GROUP BY
        M."NumeroOS"
),

TRANSF_CC_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        C."NumeroOS",
        STRING_AGG(C."CentroCustoTransferencia", ', ') AS "CentroCustoTransferencia"

    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            TB."NumeroOS",
            TB."CentroCustoTransferencia"

        FROM TRANSF_BASE TB

        WHERE
            IFNULL(TB."CentroCustoTransferencia", '') <> ''
    ) C

    GROUP BY
        C."NumeroOS"
),

TRANSF_EQ_CAND AS (
    SELECT
        TH."NumeroOS",

        EQT."insID" AS "NumeroCartaoEquipamento",
        EQT."itemCode" AS "CodigoEquipamento",
        EQT."itemName" AS "DescricaoEquipamento",
        EQT."manufSN" AS "SerieFabricante",
        EQT."customer" AS "CodigoCliente",
        EQT."custmrName" AS "NomeCliente",

        CASE
            WHEN EQT."status" = 'A' THEN 'Ativo'
            WHEN EQT."status" = 'T' THEN 'Terminado'
            WHEN EQT."status" = 'R' THEN 'Renovado'
            WHEN EQT."status" = 'L' THEN 'Emprestado'
            WHEN EQT."status" IS NULL THEN ''
            ELSE 'Nao Definido'
        END AS "StatusCartao",

        EQT."U_ICL_Horimeter" AS "HorimetroCartao",

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY TH."NumeroOS"
            ORDER BY
                EQT."insID"
        ) AS "LinhaControle"

    FROM TRANSF_HEADER TH

    INNER JOIN OINS EQT
        ON EQT."itemCode" LIKE 'T%'
        AND UPPER(IFNULL(TH."ObservacaoInternaTransferencia", '')) LIKE
            '%' || UPPER(EQT."itemCode") || '%'
),

TRANSF_EQ_UNICO AS (
    SELECT
        E."NumeroOS",
        E."NumeroCartaoEquipamento",
        E."CodigoEquipamento",
        E."DescricaoEquipamento",
        E."SerieFabricante",
        E."CodigoCliente",
        E."NomeCliente",
        E."StatusCartao",
        E."HorimetroCartao"

    FROM TRANSF_EQ_CAND E

    WHERE
        E."LinhaControle" = 1
),

TRANSF_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        DOC."NumeroOS",
        DOC."PedidosTransferencia",
        DOC."UltimaDataTransferencia",
        IFNULL(MAT."ValorTransferenciaEstoque", 0) AS "ValorTransferenciaEstoque",
        IFNULL(MAT."MateriaisTransferencia", '') AS "MateriaisTransferencia",
        IFNULL(CC."CentroCustoTransferencia", '') AS "CentroCustoTransferencia",
        CLI."CodigoClienteTransferencia",
        CLI."NomeClienteTransferencia"

    FROM TRANSF_DOC_AGR DOC

    LEFT JOIN TRANSF_MAT_AGR MAT
        ON MAT."NumeroOS" = DOC."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN TRANSF_CC_AGR CC
        ON CC."NumeroOS" = DOC."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN TRANSF_CLIENTE_UNICO CLI
        ON CLI."NumeroOS" = DOC."NumeroOS"
),

PV_OS_CANDIDATOS AS (
    SELECT
        OSB."NumeroOS",

        PV."DocEntry" AS "DocEntryPedidoVenda",
        PV."DocNum" AS "PedidoVenda",
        PV."DocDate" AS "DataPedidoVenda",
        PV."DocTotal" AS "ValorPedidoVenda",
        PV."CardCode" AS "CodigoClientePedidoVenda",
        PV."CardName" AS "NomeClientePedidoVenda",

        CASE
            WHEN PV."U_LOC1_CallID" = OSB."NumeroOS"
            THEN 1
            ELSE 2
        END AS "PrioridadeVinculo"

    FROM OS_BASE OSB

    INNER JOIN ORDR PV
        ON PV."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '4'
        AND (
            PV."U_LOC1_CallID" = OSB."NumeroOS"

            OR UPPER(IFNULL(PV."Comments", '')) LIKE
                '%CHAMADO DE SERVIÇO ' || TO_VARCHAR(OSB."NumeroOS") || ' (%'

            OR UPPER(IFNULL(PV."Comments", '')) LIKE
                '%CHAMADO DE SERVICO ' || TO_VARCHAR(OSB."NumeroOS") || ' (%'
        )
),

PV_OS_RANK AS (
    SELECT
        P."NumeroOS",
        P."DocEntryPedidoVenda",
        P."PedidoVenda",
        P."DataPedidoVenda",
        P."ValorPedidoVenda",
        P."CodigoClientePedidoVenda",
        P."NomeClientePedidoVenda",

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY P."NumeroOS"
            ORDER BY
                P."PrioridadeVinculo",
                P."DataPedidoVenda" DESC,
                P."PedidoVenda" DESC
        ) AS "LinhaControle"

    FROM PV_OS_CANDIDATOS P
),

PV_OS_UNICO AS (
    SELECT
        P."NumeroOS",
        P."PedidoVenda" AS "PedidoVendaGeradoOS",
        P."DataPedidoVenda" AS "DataPedidoVendaGeradoOS",
        P."ValorPedidoVenda" AS "ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS",
        P."CodigoClientePedidoVenda",
        P."NomeClientePedidoVenda"

    FROM PV_OS_RANK P

    WHERE
        P."LinhaControle" = 1
),

RELATORIO AS (
    SELECT
        OSB."NumeroContratoLOC1",

        IFNULL(OSB."NumeroCartaoEquipamento", TEQ."NumeroCartaoEquipamento") AS "NumeroCartaoEquipamento",
        IFNULL(OSB."CodigoEquipamento", TEQ."CodigoEquipamento") AS "CodigoEquipamento",
        IFNULL(OSB."DescricaoEquipamento", TEQ."DescricaoEquipamento") AS "DescricaoEquipamento",
        IFNULL(OSB."SerieFabricante", TEQ."SerieFabricante") AS "SerieFabricante",

        IFNULL(
            IFNULL(OSB."CodigoCliente", TEQ."CodigoCliente"),
            IFNULL(TRF."CodigoClienteTransferencia", PVG."CodigoClientePedidoVenda")
        ) AS "CodigoCliente",

        IFNULL(
            IFNULL(OSB."NomeCliente", TEQ."NomeCliente"),
            IFNULL(TRF."NomeClienteTransferencia", PVG."NomeClientePedidoVenda")
        ) AS "NomeCliente",

        IFNULL(OSB."StatusCartao", TEQ."StatusCartao") AS "StatusCartao",
        IFNULL(OSB."HorimetroCartao", TEQ."HorimetroCartao") AS "HorimetroCartao",

        OSB."NumeroOS",
        OSB."DocumentoOS",
        OSB."DataCriacaoOS",
        OSB."DataFechamentoOS",

        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN LENGTH(IFNULL(OSB."AssuntoOS", '')) > 120
                THEN SUBSTRING(OSB."AssuntoOS", 1, 120) || '...'
                ELSE IFNULL(OSB."AssuntoOS", '')
            END
            AS NVARCHAR(123)
        ) AS "AssuntoOS",

        OSB."StatusOS",

        CASE
            WHEN IFNULL(OSB."CentroCustoOS", '') <> ''
            THEN OSB."CentroCustoOS"

            WHEN IFNULL(TRF."CentroCustoTransferencia", '') <> ''
            THEN TRF."CentroCustoTransferencia"

            ELSE ''
        END AS "CentroCustoOS",

        IFNULL(TRF."PedidosTransferencia", '') AS "PedidosTransferencia",
        TRF."UltimaDataTransferencia",
        IFNULL(TRF."ValorTransferenciaEstoque", 0) AS "ValorTransferenciaEstoque",
        IFNULL(TRF."MateriaisTransferencia", '') AS "MateriaisTransferencia",

        PVG."PedidoVendaGeradoOS",
        PVG."DataPedidoVendaGeradoOS",
        IFNULL(PVG."ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS", 0) AS "ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS",

        (
            IFNULL(TRF."ValorTransferenciaEstoque", 0)
            +
            IFNULL(PVG."ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS", 0)
        ) AS "CustoTotalOS"

    FROM OS_BASE OSB

    LEFT JOIN TRANSF_AGR TRF
        ON TRF."NumeroOS" = OSB."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN TRANSF_EQ_UNICO TEQ
        ON TEQ."NumeroOS" = OSB."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN PV_OS_UNICO PVG
        ON PVG."NumeroOS" = OSB."NumeroOS"
)

SELECT
    R."NumeroContratoLOC1" AS "Numero Contrato LOC1",
    R."NumeroCartaoEquipamento" AS "Numero Cartao Equipamento",
    R."CodigoEquipamento" AS "Codigo Equipamento",
    R."DescricaoEquipamento" AS "Descricao Equipamento",
    R."SerieFabricante" AS "Serie Fabricante",
    R."CodigoCliente" AS "Codigo Cliente",
    R."NomeCliente" AS "Nome Cliente",
    R."StatusCartao" AS "Status Cartao",
    R."HorimetroCartao" AS "Horimetro Cartao",

    R."NumeroOS" AS "Numero OS",
    R."DocumentoOS" AS "Documento OS",
    R."DataCriacaoOS" AS "Data Criacao OS",
    R."DataFechamentoOS" AS "Data Fechamento OS",
    R."AssuntoOS" AS "Assunto OS",
    R."StatusOS" AS "Status OS",
    R."CentroCustoOS" AS "Centro Custo OS",

    R."PedidosTransferencia" AS "Pedidos Transferencia",
    R."UltimaDataTransferencia" AS "Ultima Data Transferencia",
    R."ValorTransferenciaEstoque" AS "Valor Transferencia Estoque",
    R."MateriaisTransferencia" AS "Materiais Transferencia",

    R."PedidoVendaGeradoOS" AS "Pedido Venda Gerado OS",
    R."DataPedidoVendaGeradoOS" AS "Data Pedido Venda Gerado OS",
    R."ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS" AS "Valor Pedido Venda Gerado OS",

    R."CustoTotalOS" AS "Custo Total OS",

    CASE
        WHEN R."ValorTransferenciaEstoque" = 0
         AND R."ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS" = 0
        THEN 'Sem custo vinculado'

        WHEN R."ValorTransferenciaEstoque" > 0
         AND R."ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS" > 0
        THEN 'Custo por transferencia e pedido gerado por OS'

        WHEN R."ValorTransferenciaEstoque" > 0
        THEN 'Custo por transferencia de estoque'

        WHEN R."ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS" > 0
        THEN 'Custo por pedido de venda gerado por OS'

        ELSE 'Validar'
    END AS "Origem Custo OS"

FROM RELATORIO R

ORDER BY
    R."NomeCliente",
    R."CodigoEquipamento",
    R."NumeroCartaoEquipamento",
    R."NumeroOS";
```

Com isso, a OS `4313` deve preencher o cliente pela própria OS ou pelo pedido de venda `5312`. Já os casos vindos só de transferência passam a preencher pelo cabeçalho do pedido de transferência.

Perfeito, Danilo — vou reescrever mantendo o racional atual do relatório por OS, mas ajustando a saída para favorecer as setinhas do SAP nos campos que podem abrir documento/cadastro. ## Mensagem 619 | assistant | 08/26/2026 14:58:39

Sim — abaixo está a versão revisada com as setinhas priorizadas nos campos que conseguem abrir cadastro/documento no SAP B1.

Observação importante: `Pedidos Transferencia` continua consolidado em texto, então normalmente não gera seta. Para navegação, incluí `Pedido Transferencia Ref`, que traz um dos pedidos de transferência vinculado à OS com seta de acesso.

```sql
WITH TRANSF_HEADER AS (
    SELECT
        TR0."DocEntry" AS "DocEntryTransferencia",
        TR0."DocNum" AS "PedidoTransferencia",
        TR0."DocDate" AS "DataTransferencia",
        TR0."U_MM_OS" AS "NumeroOS",
        TR0."CardCode" AS "CodigoClienteTransferencia",
        TR0."CardName" AS "NomeClienteTransferencia",

        CAST(
            SUBSTRING(TR0."U_MM_OBS_INTERNO", 1, 5000)
            AS NVARCHAR(5000)
        ) AS "ObservacaoInternaTransferencia"

    FROM OWTQ TR0

    WHERE
        TR0."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND TR0."U_MM_OS" IS NOT NULL
),

OS_NUMEROS AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        OS0."callID" AS "NumeroOS"
    FROM OSCL OS0

    UNION

    SELECT DISTINCT
        TH."NumeroOS"
    FROM TRANSF_HEADER TH

    UNION

    SELECT DISTINCT
        PV."U_LOC1_CallID" AS "NumeroOS"
    FROM ORDR PV
    WHERE
        PV."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '4'
        AND PV."U_LOC1_CallID" IS NOT NULL
),

OS_BASE AS (
    SELECT
        O."NumeroOS",

        OS0."DocNum" AS "DocumentoOS",
        OS0."contractID" AS "NumeroContratoLOC1",
        OS0."createDate" AS "DataCriacaoOS",
        OS0."closeDate" AS "DataFechamentoOS",
        OS0."subject" AS "AssuntoOS",

        CASE
            WHEN OS0."status" = -3 THEN 'Aberto'
            WHEN OS0."status" = -2 THEN 'Pendente'
            WHEN OS0."status" = -1 THEN 'Fechado'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 1 THEN 'Aguardando Pecas'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 2 THEN 'Encerrado IClass'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 3 THEN 'Enviar IClass'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 4 THEN 'Enviado IClass'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 5 THEN 'Equipamento Parado'
            WHEN OS0."status" IS NULL THEN ''
            ELSE 'Nao Definido'
        END AS "StatusOS",

        CASE
            WHEN IFNULL(CCOS."OcrName", '') <> ''
            THEN CCOS."OcrName"
            WHEN OS0."U_MM_CC" = '6' THEN 'Gerador'
            WHEN OS0."U_MM_CC" = '7' THEN 'Locacao'
            WHEN OS0."U_MM_CC" = '10' THEN 'Nobreak'
            WHEN OS0."U_MM_CC" = '3' THEN 'Execucao Eletrica'
            WHEN IFNULL(OS0."U_MM_CC", '') = '' THEN ''
            ELSE OS0."U_MM_CC"
        END AS "CentroCustoOS",

        EQ."insID" AS "NumeroCartaoEquipamento",

        IFNULL(EQ."itemCode", OS0."itemCode") AS "CodigoEquipamento",
        IFNULL(EQ."itemName", OS0."itemName") AS "DescricaoEquipamento",
        IFNULL(EQ."manufSN", OS0."manufSN") AS "SerieFabricante",

        IFNULL(EQ."customer", OS0."customer") AS "CodigoCliente",
        IFNULL(EQ."custmrName", OS0."custmrName") AS "NomeCliente",

        CASE
            WHEN EQ."status" = 'A' THEN 'Ativo'
            WHEN EQ."status" = 'T' THEN 'Terminado'
            WHEN EQ."status" = 'R' THEN 'Renovado'
            WHEN EQ."status" = 'L' THEN 'Emprestado'
            WHEN EQ."status" IS NULL THEN ''
            ELSE 'Nao Definido'
        END AS "StatusCartao",

        EQ."U_ICL_Horimeter" AS "HorimetroCartao"

    FROM OS_NUMEROS O

    LEFT JOIN OSCL OS0
        ON OS0."callID" = O."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN OINS EQ
        ON EQ."insID" = OS0."insID"

    LEFT JOIN OOCR CCOS
        ON CCOS."OcrCode" = OS0."U_MM_CC"
),

TRANSF_BASE AS (
    SELECT
        TH."NumeroOS",
        TH."DocEntryTransferencia",
        TH."PedidoTransferencia",
        TH."DataTransferencia",
        TH."CodigoClienteTransferencia",
        TH."NomeClienteTransferencia",
        TH."ObservacaoInternaTransferencia",

        TR1."ItemCode" AS "CodigoMaterial",
        TR1."Dscription" AS "DescricaoMaterial",
        TR1."Quantity" AS "QuantidadeMaterial",
        TR1."LineTotal" AS "ValorMaterialLinha",

        IFNULL(CCTR."OcrName", TR1."OcrCode") AS "CentroCustoTransferencia"

    FROM TRANSF_HEADER TH

    INNER JOIN WTQ1 TR1
        ON TR1."DocEntry" = TH."DocEntryTransferencia"

    LEFT JOIN OOCR CCTR
        ON CCTR."OcrCode" = TR1."OcrCode"
),

TRANSF_DOC_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        D."NumeroOS",
        STRING_AGG(D."PedidoTransferenciaTexto", ', ') AS "PedidosTransferencia",
        MAX(D."DataTransferencia") AS "UltimaDataTransferencia"

    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            TH."NumeroOS",
            TO_VARCHAR(TH."PedidoTransferencia") AS "PedidoTransferenciaTexto",
            TH."DataTransferencia"

        FROM TRANSF_HEADER TH
    ) D

    GROUP BY
        D."NumeroOS"
),

TRANSF_DOC_REF AS (
    SELECT
        X."NumeroOS",
        X."DocEntryTransferencia"

    FROM (
        SELECT
            TH."NumeroOS",
            TH."DocEntryTransferencia",

            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY TH."NumeroOS"
                ORDER BY
                    TH."DataTransferencia" DESC,
                    TH."PedidoTransferencia" DESC
            ) AS "LinhaControle"

        FROM TRANSF_HEADER TH
    ) X

    WHERE
        X."LinhaControle" = 1
),

TRANSF_CLIENTE_RANK AS (
    SELECT
        TH."NumeroOS",
        TH."CodigoClienteTransferencia",
        TH."NomeClienteTransferencia",

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY TH."NumeroOS"
            ORDER BY
                TH."DataTransferencia" DESC,
                TH."PedidoTransferencia" DESC
        ) AS "LinhaControle"

    FROM TRANSF_HEADER TH
),

TRANSF_CLIENTE_UNICO AS (
    SELECT
        T."NumeroOS",
        T."CodigoClienteTransferencia",
        T."NomeClienteTransferencia"

    FROM TRANSF_CLIENTE_RANK T

    WHERE
        T."LinhaControle" = 1
),

TRANSF_MAT_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        M."NumeroOS",
        SUM(M."ValorMaterialLinha") AS "ValorTransferenciaEstoque",
        STRING_AGG(M."MateriaisTexto", ' | ') AS "MateriaisTransferencia"

    FROM (
        SELECT
            TB."NumeroOS",
            TB."ValorMaterialLinha",

            TB."CodigoMaterial"
                || ' - '
                || TB."DescricaoMaterial"
                || ' - Qtd: '
                || TO_VARCHAR(TB."QuantidadeMaterial") AS "MateriaisTexto"

        FROM TRANSF_BASE TB
    ) M

    GROUP BY
        M."NumeroOS"
),

TRANSF_CC_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        C."NumeroOS",
        STRING_AGG(C."CentroCustoTransferencia", ', ') AS "CentroCustoTransferencia"

    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            TB."NumeroOS",
            TB."CentroCustoTransferencia"

        FROM TRANSF_BASE TB

        WHERE
            IFNULL(TB."CentroCustoTransferencia", '') <> ''
    ) C

    GROUP BY
        C."NumeroOS"
),

TRANSF_EQ_CAND AS (
    SELECT
        TH."NumeroOS",

        EQT."insID" AS "NumeroCartaoEquipamento",
        EQT."itemCode" AS "CodigoEquipamento",
        EQT."itemName" AS "DescricaoEquipamento",
        EQT."manufSN" AS "SerieFabricante",
        EQT."customer" AS "CodigoCliente",
        EQT."custmrName" AS "NomeCliente",

        CASE
            WHEN EQT."status" = 'A' THEN 'Ativo'
            WHEN EQT."status" = 'T' THEN 'Terminado'
            WHEN EQT."status" = 'R' THEN 'Renovado'
            WHEN EQT."status" = 'L' THEN 'Emprestado'
            WHEN EQT."status" IS NULL THEN ''
            ELSE 'Nao Definido'
        END AS "StatusCartao",

        EQT."U_ICL_Horimeter" AS "HorimetroCartao",

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY TH."NumeroOS"
            ORDER BY
                EQT."insID"
        ) AS "LinhaControle"

    FROM TRANSF_HEADER TH

    INNER JOIN OINS EQT
        ON UPPER(IFNULL(TH."ObservacaoInternaTransferencia", '')) LIKE
            '%' || UPPER(EQT."itemCode") || '%'
),

TRANSF_EQ_UNICO AS (
    SELECT
        E."NumeroOS",
        E."NumeroCartaoEquipamento",
        E."CodigoEquipamento",
        E."DescricaoEquipamento",
        E."SerieFabricante",
        E."CodigoCliente",
        E."NomeCliente",
        E."StatusCartao",
        E."HorimetroCartao"

    FROM TRANSF_EQ_CAND E

    WHERE
        E."LinhaControle" = 1
),

TRANSF_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        DOC."NumeroOS",
        REF."DocEntryTransferencia" AS "DocEntryTransferenciaRef",
        DOC."PedidosTransferencia",
        DOC."UltimaDataTransferencia",
        IFNULL(MAT."ValorTransferenciaEstoque", 0) AS "ValorTransferenciaEstoque",
        IFNULL(MAT."MateriaisTransferencia", '') AS "MateriaisTransferencia",
        IFNULL(CC."CentroCustoTransferencia", '') AS "CentroCustoTransferencia",
        CLI."CodigoClienteTransferencia",
        CLI."NomeClienteTransferencia"

    FROM TRANSF_DOC_AGR DOC

    LEFT JOIN TRANSF_DOC_REF REF
        ON REF."NumeroOS" = DOC."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN TRANSF_MAT_AGR MAT
        ON MAT."NumeroOS" = DOC."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN TRANSF_CC_AGR CC
        ON CC."NumeroOS" = DOC."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN TRANSF_CLIENTE_UNICO CLI
        ON CLI."NumeroOS" = DOC."NumeroOS"
),

PV_OS_CANDIDATOS AS (
    SELECT
        OSB."NumeroOS",

        PV."DocEntry" AS "DocEntryPedidoVenda",
        PV."DocNum" AS "PedidoVenda",
        PV."DocDate" AS "DataPedidoVenda",
        PV."DocTotal" AS "ValorPedidoVenda",
        PV."CardCode" AS "CodigoClientePedidoVenda",
        PV."CardName" AS "NomeClientePedidoVenda",

        CASE
            WHEN PV."U_LOC1_CallID" = OSB."NumeroOS"
            THEN 1
            ELSE 2
        END AS "PrioridadeVinculo"

    FROM OS_BASE OSB

    INNER JOIN ORDR PV
        ON PV."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '4'
        AND (
            PV."U_LOC1_CallID" = OSB."NumeroOS"

            OR UPPER(IFNULL(PV."Comments", '')) LIKE
                '%CHAMADO DE SERVIÇO ' || TO_VARCHAR(OSB."NumeroOS") || ' (%'

            OR UPPER(IFNULL(PV."Comments", '')) LIKE
                '%CHAMADO DE SERVICO ' || TO_VARCHAR(OSB."NumeroOS") || ' (%'
        )
),

PV_OS_RANK AS (
    SELECT
        P."NumeroOS",
        P."DocEntryPedidoVenda",
        P."PedidoVenda",
        P."DataPedidoVenda",
        P."ValorPedidoVenda",
        P."CodigoClientePedidoVenda",
        P."NomeClientePedidoVenda",

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY P."NumeroOS"
            ORDER BY
                P."PrioridadeVinculo",
                P."DataPedidoVenda" DESC,
                P."PedidoVenda" DESC
        ) AS "LinhaControle"

    FROM PV_OS_CANDIDATOS P
),

PV_OS_UNICO AS (
    SELECT
        P."NumeroOS",
        P."DocEntryPedidoVenda",
        P."PedidoVenda" AS "PedidoVendaGeradoOS",
        P."DataPedidoVenda" AS "DataPedidoVendaGeradoOS",
        P."ValorPedidoVenda" AS "ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS",
        P."CodigoClientePedidoVenda",
        P."NomeClientePedidoVenda"

    FROM PV_OS_RANK P

    WHERE
        P."LinhaControle" = 1
),

RELATORIO AS (
    SELECT
        OSB."NumeroContratoLOC1",

        IFNULL(OSB."NumeroCartaoEquipamento", TEQ."NumeroCartaoEquipamento") AS "NumeroCartaoEquipamento",
        IFNULL(OSB."CodigoEquipamento", TEQ."CodigoEquipamento") AS "CodigoEquipamento",
        IFNULL(OSB."DescricaoEquipamento", TEQ."DescricaoEquipamento") AS "DescricaoEquipamento",
        IFNULL(OSB."SerieFabricante", TEQ."SerieFabricante") AS "SerieFabricante",

        IFNULL(
            IFNULL(OSB."CodigoCliente", TEQ."CodigoCliente"),
            IFNULL(TRF."CodigoClienteTransferencia", PVG."CodigoClientePedidoVenda")
        ) AS "CodigoCliente",

        IFNULL(
            IFNULL(OSB."NomeCliente", TEQ."NomeCliente"),
            IFNULL(TRF."NomeClienteTransferencia", PVG."NomeClientePedidoVenda")
        ) AS "NomeCliente",

        IFNULL(OSB."StatusCartao", TEQ."StatusCartao") AS "StatusCartao",
        IFNULL(OSB."HorimetroCartao", TEQ."HorimetroCartao") AS "HorimetroCartao",

        OSB."NumeroOS",
        OSB."DocumentoOS",
        OSB."DataCriacaoOS",
        OSB."DataFechamentoOS",

        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN LENGTH(IFNULL(OSB."AssuntoOS", '')) > 120
                THEN SUBSTRING(OSB."AssuntoOS", 1, 120) || '...'
                ELSE IFNULL(OSB."AssuntoOS", '')
            END
            AS NVARCHAR(123)
        ) AS "AssuntoOS",

        OSB."StatusOS",

        CASE
            WHEN IFNULL(OSB."CentroCustoOS", '') <> ''
            THEN OSB."CentroCustoOS"

            WHEN IFNULL(TRF."CentroCustoTransferencia", '') <> ''
            THEN TRF."CentroCustoTransferencia"

            ELSE ''
        END AS "CentroCustoOS",

        TRF."DocEntryTransferenciaRef",
        IFNULL(TRF."PedidosTransferencia", '') AS "PedidosTransferencia",
        TRF."UltimaDataTransferencia",
        IFNULL(TRF."ValorTransferenciaEstoque", 0) AS "ValorTransferenciaEstoque",
        IFNULL(TRF."MateriaisTransferencia", '') AS "MateriaisTransferencia",

        PVG."DocEntryPedidoVenda",
        PVG."PedidoVendaGeradoOS",
        PVG."DataPedidoVendaGeradoOS",
        IFNULL(PVG."ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS", 0) AS "ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS",

        (
            IFNULL(TRF."ValorTransferenciaEstoque", 0)
            +
            IFNULL(PVG."ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS", 0)
        ) AS "CustoTotalOS"

    FROM OS_BASE OSB

    LEFT JOIN TRANSF_AGR TRF
        ON TRF."NumeroOS" = OSB."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN TRANSF_EQ_UNICO TEQ
        ON TEQ."NumeroOS" = OSB."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN PV_OS_UNICO PVG
        ON PVG."NumeroOS" = OSB."NumeroOS"
)

SELECT
    CT_LINK."ContractID" AS "Numero Contrato LOC1",

    EQ_LINK."insID" AS "Numero Cartao Equipamento",
    ITEM_LINK."ItemCode" AS "Codigo Equipamento",
    ITEM_LINK."ItemName" AS "Descricao Equipamento",
    R."SerieFabricante" AS "Serie Fabricante",

    BP_LINK."CardCode" AS "Codigo Cliente",
    BP_LINK."CardName" AS "Nome Cliente",

    R."StatusCartao" AS "Status Cartao",
    R."HorimetroCartao" AS "Horimetro Cartao",

    OS_LINK."callID" AS "Numero OS",
    OS_LINK."DocNum" AS "Documento OS",
    R."DataCriacaoOS" AS "Data Criacao OS",
    R."DataFechamentoOS" AS "Data Fechamento OS",
    R."AssuntoOS" AS "Assunto OS",
    R."StatusOS" AS "Status OS",
    R."CentroCustoOS" AS "Centro Custo OS",

    TR_LINK."DocNum" AS "Pedido Transferencia Ref",
    R."PedidosTransferencia" AS "Pedidos Transferencia",
    R."UltimaDataTransferencia" AS "Ultima Data Transferencia",
    R."ValorTransferenciaEstoque" AS "Valor Transferencia Estoque",
    R."MateriaisTransferencia" AS "Materiais Transferencia",

    PV_LINK."DocNum" AS "Pedido Venda Gerado OS",
    R."DataPedidoVendaGeradoOS" AS "Data Pedido Venda Gerado OS",
    R."ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS" AS "Valor Pedido Venda Gerado OS",

    R."CustoTotalOS" AS "Custo Total OS",

    CASE
        WHEN R."ValorTransferenciaEstoque" = 0
         AND R."ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS" = 0
        THEN 'Sem custo vinculado'

        WHEN R."ValorTransferenciaEstoque" > 0
         AND R."ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS" > 0
        THEN 'Custo por transferencia e pedido gerado por OS'

        WHEN R."ValorTransferenciaEstoque" > 0
        THEN 'Custo por transferencia de estoque'

        WHEN R."ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS" > 0
        THEN 'Custo por pedido de venda gerado por OS'

        ELSE 'Validar'
    END AS "Origem Custo OS"

FROM RELATORIO R

LEFT JOIN OCTR CT_LINK
    ON CT_LINK."ContractID" = R."NumeroContratoLOC1"

LEFT JOIN OINS EQ_LINK
    ON EQ_LINK."insID" = R."NumeroCartaoEquipamento"

LEFT JOIN OITM ITEM_LINK
    ON ITEM_LINK."ItemCode" = R."CodigoEquipamento"

LEFT JOIN OCRD BP_LINK
    ON BP_LINK."CardCode" = R."CodigoCliente"

LEFT JOIN OSCL OS_LINK
    ON OS_LINK."callID" = R."NumeroOS"

LEFT JOIN OWTQ TR_LINK
    ON TR_LINK."DocEntry" = R."DocEntryTransferenciaRef"

LEFT JOIN ORDR PV_LINK
    ON PV_LINK."DocEntry" = R."DocEntryPedidoVenda"

ORDER BY
    BP_LINK."CardName",
    ITEM_LINK."ItemCode",
    EQ_LINK."insID",
    OS_LINK."callID";
```

Se alguma seta ainda não aparecer, provavelmente é limitação do SAP quando o campo passa por CTE/relatório consolidado. Mas nesta versão os principais campos de navegação estão selecionados diretamente das tabelas finais: `OCTR`, `OINS`, `OITM`, `OCRD`, `OSCL`, `OWTQ` e `ORDR`.

## Mensagem 624 | assistant | 09/03/2026 14:22:56

Perfeito, Danilo. Fiz a alteração de forma cirúrgica:

- inclui `T0."U_MM_NumNFSe"` logo após `Numero_Nota_Fiscal`;
- criei a identificação técnica de NF de serviço quando existir item da nota com código iniciado por `SV`;
- acrescentei a auditoria `Validar: NF nao transmitida` na coluna `Status_Vinculo_Pedido`;
- mantive todo o restante da estrutura validada.

```sql
SELECT
    T0."DocEntry" AS "Num_Interno_NF",
    T0."DocNum" AS "Num_Documento_SAP",
    T0."Serial" AS "Numero_Nota_Fiscal",
    T0."U_MM_NumNFSe" AS "Numero_NFSe",

    T0."DocDate" AS "Data_Emissao",

    CASE
        WHEN ENT."Data_Entrega" IS NOT NULL
        THEN ENT."Data_Entrega"
        ELSE T0."DocDate"
    END AS "Data_Referencia_Faturamento",

    T0."CardCode" AS "Cod_Cliente",
    T0."CardName" AS "Nome_Cliente",

    CASE
        WHEN UPPER(IFNULL(FIL."BPLName", '')) LIKE '%ENGENHARIA%'
        THEN 'Sistel Engenharia'

        WHEN UPPER(IFNULL(FIL."BPLName", '')) LIKE '%COMERCIO%'
          OR UPPER(IFNULL(FIL."BPLName", '')) LIKE '%COMÉRCIO%'
        THEN 'Sistel Comercio'

        ELSE IFNULL(FIL."BPLName", 'Nao Definido')
    END AS "Filial",

    CASE
        WHEN ENT."Num_Documento_Entrega" IS NOT NULL
        THEN 'Nota Fiscal de Entrega Futura com Entrega Vinculada'
        ELSE 'Nota Fiscal de Saida'
    END AS "Tipo_Nota_Fiscal",

    PV."DocNum" AS "Pedido_Venda",

    CASE
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '0' THEN 'Nao Definido'
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '2' THEN 'Aditivo'
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '3' THEN 'Pre-Contrato'
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '4' THEN 'Gerado por OS (Pre-Consumo)'
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '5' THEN 'Venda (Avulsa)'
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '6' THEN 'Faturamento LOC1'
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '9' THEN 'Precor'
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '10' THEN 'Integrado por Iclass'
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '7' THEN 'Ajuste interno'
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '8' THEN 'Duplicado'
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '11' THEN 'Cancelado'
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" IS NULL THEN 'Sem Pedido de Venda'
        ELSE 'Nao Definido'
    END AS "Tipo_Pedido",

    LIN."Departamento" AS "Departamento",

    LIN."Utilizacao" AS "Utilizacao",

    CASE
        WHEN ENT."Valor_Entrega" IS NOT NULL
        THEN ENT."Valor_Entrega"
        ELSE T0."NfeValue"
    END AS "Valor_NFe_ML",

    ENT."Num_Interno_Entrega" AS "Num_Interno_Entrega",
    ENT."Num_Documento_Entrega" AS "Num_Documento_Entrega",
    ENT."Data_Entrega" AS "Data_Entrega",

    CASE
        WHEN LIN."NotaServico" = 'Y'
         AND IFNULL(T0."U_MM_NumNFSe", '') = ''
        THEN 'Validar: NF nao transmitida'

        WHEN PV."DocNum" IS NULL
        THEN 'Validar: NF sem vinculo com Pedido de Venda'

        WHEN ENT."Num_Documento_Entrega" IS NOT NULL
        THEN 'OK: NF futura com entrega vinculada'

        ELSE 'OK: NF vinculada ao Pedido de Venda'
    END AS "Status_Vinculo_Pedido"

FROM OINV T0

LEFT JOIN OBPL FIL
    ON FIL."BPLId" = T0."BPLId"

INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
        X."DocEntryNF",
        X."DocEntryPV",
        X."Departamento",
        X."Utilizacao",
        X."NotaServico"

    FROM (
        SELECT
            I1."DocEntry" AS "DocEntryNF",

            CASE
                WHEN I1."BaseType" = 17
                THEN I1."BaseEntry"
                ELSE NULL
            END AS "DocEntryPV",

            IFNULL(I1."OcrCode", R1."OcrCode") AS "Departamento",

            U."Usage" AS "Utilizacao",

            CASE
                WHEN MAX(
                    CASE
                        WHEN UPPER(IFNULL(I1."ItemCode", '')) LIKE 'SV%'
                        THEN 1
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ) OVER (PARTITION BY I1."DocEntry") = 1
                THEN 'Y'
                ELSE 'N'
            END AS "NotaServico",

            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY I1."DocEntry"
                ORDER BY
                    I1."LineNum"
            ) AS "LinhaControle"

        FROM INV1 I1

        LEFT JOIN RDR1 R1
            ON I1."BaseType" = 17
            AND I1."BaseEntry" = R1."DocEntry"
            AND I1."BaseLine" = R1."LineNum"

        LEFT JOIN OUSG U
            ON U."ID" = I1."Usage"

        WHERE
            IFNULL(I1."OcrCode", R1."OcrCode") IN (
                'GERADOR',
                'NOBREAK',
                'LOCACAO',
                'EXE_ELET',
                'FOTOV',
                'REV_DIRE',
                'SEMINOVO'
            )

            AND IFNULL(I1."TaxOnly", 'N') <> 'Y'
            AND IFNULL(U."TaxOnly", 'N') <> 'Y'
    ) X

    WHERE
        X."LinhaControle" = 1
) LIN
    ON LIN."DocEntryNF" = T0."DocEntry"

LEFT JOIN ORDR PV
    ON PV."DocEntry" = LIN."DocEntryPV"

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        X."DocEntryNFOrigem",
        X."Num_Interno_Entrega",
        X."Num_Documento_Entrega",
        X."Data_Entrega",
        X."Valor_Entrega"

    FROM (
        SELECT
            D1."BaseEntry" AS "DocEntryNFOrigem",
            E0."DocEntry" AS "Num_Interno_Entrega",
            E0."DocNum" AS "Num_Documento_Entrega",
            E0."DocDate" AS "Data_Entrega",
            E0."DocTotal" AS "Valor_Entrega",

            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY D1."BaseEntry"
                ORDER BY
                    E0."DocDate" DESC,
                    E0."DocNum" DESC
            ) AS "LinhaControle"

        FROM ODLN E0

        INNER JOIN DLN1 D1
            ON D1."DocEntry" = E0."DocEntry"

        WHERE
            D1."BaseType" = 13
            AND E0."CANCELED" = 'N'
    ) X

    WHERE
        X."LinhaControle" = 1
) ENT
    ON ENT."DocEntryNFOrigem" = T0."DocEntry"

WHERE
    CASE
        WHEN ENT."Data_Entrega" IS NOT NULL
        THEN ENT."Data_Entrega"
        ELSE T0."DocDate"
    END BETWEEN '[%0]' AND '[%1]'

    AND T0."CANCELED" = 'N'

    AND (
        ENT."Num_Documento_Entrega" IS NOT NULL
        OR (
            UPPER(IFNULL(LIN."Utilizacao", '')) NOT LIKE '%ENTR. FUTURA%'
            AND UPPER(IFNULL(LIN."Utilizacao", '')) NOT LIKE '%ENTREGA FUTURA%'
        )
    )

ORDER BY
    "Data_Referencia_Faturamento" DESC,
    T0."DocNum";
```

Se quiser auditar depois do teste, o principal ponto para conferir é: toda NF com item `SV%` e `Numero_NFSe` vazio deve aparecer com `Validar: NF nao transmitida`.
