## Mensagem 632 | assistant | 09/03/2026 14:32:18

Perfeito, Danilo. Exatamente: para não sobrescrever auditorias diferentes, vamos separar em duas colunas:

- `Status_Vinculo_Pedido`: audita somente se a NF está vinculada ou não ao pedido de venda.
- `Status_Transmissao_NFSe`: audita somente se a NF de serviço foi transmitida, usando `OINV."U_MM_NumNFSe"`.

Segue a query completa revisada:

```sql
SELECT
    T0."DocEntry" AS "Num_Interno_NF",
    T0."DocNum" AS "Num_Documento_SAP",
    T0."Serial" AS "Numero_Nota_Fiscal",
    T0."U_MM_NumNFSe" AS "Numero_NFSe",

    T0."DocDate" AS "Data_Emissao",

    CASE
        WHEN ENT."Data_Entrega" IS NOT NULL
        THEN ENT."Data_Entrega"
        ELSE T0."DocDate"
    END AS "Data_Referencia_Faturamento",

    T0."CardCode" AS "Cod_Cliente",
    T0."CardName" AS "Nome_Cliente",

    CASE
        WHEN UPPER(IFNULL(FIL."BPLName", '')) LIKE '%ENGENHARIA%'
        THEN 'Sistel Engenharia'

        WHEN UPPER(IFNULL(FIL."BPLName", '')) LIKE '%COMERCIO%'
          OR UPPER(IFNULL(FIL."BPLName", '')) LIKE '%COMÉRCIO%'
        THEN 'Sistel Comercio'

        ELSE IFNULL(FIL."BPLName", 'Nao Definido')
    END AS "Filial",

    CASE
        WHEN ENT."Num_Documento_Entrega" IS NOT NULL
        THEN 'Nota Fiscal de Entrega Futura com Entrega Vinculada'
        ELSE 'Nota Fiscal de Saida'
    END AS "Tipo_Nota_Fiscal",

    PV."DocNum" AS "Pedido_Venda",

    CASE
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '0' THEN 'Nao Definido'
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '2' THEN 'Aditivo'
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '3' THEN 'Pre-Contrato'
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '4' THEN 'Gerado por OS (Pre-Consumo)'
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '5' THEN 'Venda (Avulsa)'
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '6' THEN 'Faturamento LOC1'
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '9' THEN 'Precor'
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '10' THEN 'Integrado por Iclass'
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '7' THEN 'Ajuste interno'
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '8' THEN 'Duplicado'
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '11' THEN 'Cancelado'
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" IS NULL THEN 'Sem Pedido de Venda'
        ELSE 'Nao Definido'
    END AS "Tipo_Pedido",

    LIN."Departamento" AS "Departamento",

    LIN."Utilizacao" AS "Utilizacao",

    CASE
        WHEN ENT."Valor_Entrega" IS NOT NULL
        THEN ENT."Valor_Entrega"
        ELSE T0."NfeValue"
    END AS "Valor_NFe_ML",

    ENT."Num_Interno_Entrega" AS "Num_Interno_Entrega",
    ENT."Num_Documento_Entrega" AS "Num_Documento_Entrega",
    ENT."Data_Entrega" AS "Data_Entrega",

    CASE
        WHEN PV."DocNum" IS NULL
        THEN 'Validar: NF sem vinculo com Pedido de Venda'

        WHEN ENT."Num_Documento_Entrega" IS NOT NULL
        THEN 'OK: NF futura com entrega vinculada'

        ELSE 'OK: NF vinculada ao Pedido de Venda'
    END AS "Status_Vinculo_Pedido",

    CASE
        WHEN LIN."NotaServico" = 'Y'
         AND IFNULL(T0."U_MM_NumNFSe", '') = ''
        THEN 'Validar: NF nao transmitida'

        WHEN LIN."NotaServico" = 'Y'
         AND IFNULL(T0."U_MM_NumNFSe", '') <> ''
        THEN 'OK: NFSe transmitida'

        ELSE 'Nao aplicavel: NF nao e servico'
    END AS "Status_Transmissao_NFSe"

FROM OINV T0

LEFT JOIN OBPL FIL
    ON FIL."BPLId" = T0."BPLId"

INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
        X."DocEntryNF",
        X."DocEntryPV",
        X."Departamento",
        X."Utilizacao",
        X."NotaServico"

    FROM (
        SELECT
            I1."DocEntry" AS "DocEntryNF",

            CASE
                WHEN I1."BaseType" = 17
                THEN I1."BaseEntry"
                ELSE NULL
            END AS "DocEntryPV",

            IFNULL(I1."OcrCode", R1."OcrCode") AS "Departamento",

            U."Usage" AS "Utilizacao",

            CASE
                WHEN MAX(
                    CASE
                        WHEN UPPER(IFNULL(I1."ItemCode", '')) LIKE 'SV%'
                        THEN 1
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ) OVER (PARTITION BY I1."DocEntry") = 1
                THEN 'Y'
                ELSE 'N'
            END AS "NotaServico",

            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY I1."DocEntry"
                ORDER BY
                    I1."LineNum"
            ) AS "LinhaControle"

        FROM INV1 I1

        LEFT JOIN RDR1 R1
            ON I1."BaseType" = 17
            AND I1."BaseEntry" = R1."DocEntry"
            AND I1."BaseLine" = R1."LineNum"

        LEFT JOIN OUSG U
            ON U."ID" = I1."Usage"

        WHERE
            IFNULL(I1."OcrCode", R1."OcrCode") IN (
                'GERADOR',
                'NOBREAK',
                'LOCACAO',
                'EXE_ELET',
                'FOTOV',
                'REV_DIRE',
                'SEMINOVO'
            )

            AND IFNULL(I1."TaxOnly", 'N') <> 'Y'
            AND IFNULL(U."TaxOnly", 'N') <> 'Y'
    ) X

    WHERE
        X."LinhaControle" = 1
) LIN
    ON LIN."DocEntryNF" = T0."DocEntry"

LEFT JOIN ORDR PV
    ON PV."DocEntry" = LIN."DocEntryPV"

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        X."DocEntryNFOrigem",
        X."Num_Interno_Entrega",
        X."Num_Documento_Entrega",
        X."Data_Entrega",
        X."Valor_Entrega"

    FROM (
        SELECT
            D1."BaseEntry" AS "DocEntryNFOrigem",
            E0."DocEntry" AS "Num_Interno_Entrega",
            E0."DocNum" AS "Num_Documento_Entrega",
            E0."DocDate" AS "Data_Entrega",
            E0."DocTotal" AS "Valor_Entrega",

            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY D1."BaseEntry"
                ORDER BY
                    E0."DocDate" DESC,
                    E0."DocNum" DESC
            ) AS "LinhaControle"

        FROM ODLN E0

        INNER JOIN DLN1 D1
            ON D1."DocEntry" = E0."DocEntry"

        WHERE
            D1."BaseType" = 13
            AND E0."CANCELED" = 'N'
    ) X

    WHERE
        X."LinhaControle" = 1
) ENT
    ON ENT."DocEntryNFOrigem" = T0."DocEntry"

WHERE
    CASE
        WHEN ENT."Data_Entrega" IS NOT NULL
        THEN ENT."Data_Entrega"
        ELSE T0."DocDate"
    END BETWEEN '[%0]' AND '[%1]'

    AND T0."CANCELED" = 'N'

    AND (
        ENT."Num_Documento_Entrega" IS NOT NULL
        OR (
            UPPER(IFNULL(LIN."Utilizacao", '')) NOT LIKE '%ENTR. FUTURA%'
            AND UPPER(IFNULL(LIN."Utilizacao", '')) NOT LIKE '%ENTREGA FUTURA%'
        )
    )

ORDER BY
    "Data_Referencia_Faturamento" DESC,
    T0."DocNum";
```

Agora uma NF pode, por exemplo, ficar assim:

`Status_Vinculo_Pedido = OK: NF vinculada ao Pedido de Venda`

e ao mesmo tempo:

`Status_Transmissao_NFSe = Validar: NF nao transmitida`

Ou seja, as auditorias não se anulam mais.

## Mensagem 637 | assistant | 09/03/2026 20:10:19

Sim, é possível — mas com uma limitação importante do SAP B1.

Hoje a coluna:

```sql
T0."Project" AS "Projeto"
```

usa o campo `OINV."Project"`, que é o código do projeto financeiro. Por isso a seta abre o cadastro/nome do projeto financeiro.

Para abrir a tela de `Gerenciamento de projetos > Projeto`, precisamos vincular esse código financeiro à tabela de projetos gerenciais `OPMG`, pelo campo:

```sql
OPMG."FIPROJECT"
```

A documentação SAP indica que `OPMG` é a tabela do módulo Project Management, com chave principal `AbsEntry`, número do projeto em `DocNum`, nome em `NAME` e projeto financeiro em `FIPROJECT`.

Então o caminho correto é:

```sql
LEFT JOIN OPMG PRJ
    ON PRJ."FIPROJECT" = T0."Project"
```

E no `SELECT`, em vez de deixar somente:

```sql
T0."Project" AS "Projeto",
```

usar uma dessas opções:

```sql
PRJ."DocNum" AS "Projeto_Gerencial",
T0."Project" AS "Projeto_Financeiro",
```

Minha recomendação para não quebrar nada: manter o projeto financeiro e adicionar o projeto gerencial ao lado. Assim você preserva o código `6185` e ganha uma coluna com seta para a tela de Gerenciamento de Projetos.

Substitua este trecho:

```sql
PV."DocNum" AS "Pedido_Venda",

T0."Project" AS "Projeto",

CASE
```

por este:


```sql
SELECT
    T0."DocEntry" AS "Num_Interno_NF",
    T0."DocNum" AS "Num_Documento_SAP",
    T0."Serial" AS "Numero_Nota_Fiscal",
    T0."U_MM_NumNFSe" AS "Numero_NFSe",

    T0."DocDate" AS "Data_Emissao",

    CASE
        WHEN ENT."Data_Entrega" IS NOT NULL
        THEN ENT."Data_Entrega"
        ELSE T0."DocDate"
    END AS "Data_Referencia_Faturamento",

    T0."CardCode" AS "Cod_Cliente",
    T0."CardName" AS "Nome_Cliente",

    CASE
        WHEN UPPER(IFNULL(FIL."BPLName", '')) LIKE '%ENGENHARIA%'
        THEN 'Sistel Engenharia'

        WHEN UPPER(IFNULL(FIL."BPLName", '')) LIKE '%COMERCIO%'
          OR UPPER(IFNULL(FIL."BPLName", '')) LIKE '%COMÉRCIO%'
        THEN 'Sistel Comercio'

        ELSE IFNULL(FIL."BPLName", 'Nao Definido')
    END AS "Filial",

    CASE
        WHEN ENT."Num_Documento_Entrega" IS NOT NULL
        THEN 'Nota Fiscal de Entrega Futura com Entrega Vinculada'
        ELSE 'Nota Fiscal de Saida'
    END AS "Tipo_Nota_Fiscal",

    PV."DocNum" AS "Pedido_Venda",

    PRJ."DocNum" AS "Projeto_Gerencial",
    T0."Project" AS "Projeto_Financeiro",

    CASE
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '0' THEN 'Nao Definido'
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '2' THEN 'Aditivo'
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '3' THEN 'Pre-Contrato'
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '4' THEN 'Gerado por OS (Pre-Consumo)'
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '5' THEN 'Venda (Avulsa)'
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '6' THEN 'Faturamento LOC1'
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '9' THEN 'Precor'
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '10' THEN 'Integrado por Iclass'
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '7' THEN 'Ajuste interno'
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '8' THEN 'Duplicado'
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '11' THEN 'Cancelado'
        WHEN PV."U_MM_Tipo" IS NULL THEN 'Sem Pedido de Venda'
        ELSE 'Nao Definido'
    END AS "Tipo_Pedido",

    LIN."Departamento" AS "Departamento",

    LIN."Utilizacao" AS "Utilizacao",

    CASE
        WHEN ENT."Valor_Entrega" IS NOT NULL
        THEN ENT."Valor_Entrega"
        ELSE T0."NfeValue"
    END AS "Valor_NFe_ML",

    ENT."Num_Interno_Entrega" AS "Num_Interno_Entrega",
    ENT."Num_Documento_Entrega" AS "Num_Documento_Entrega",
    ENT."Data_Entrega" AS "Data_Entrega",

    CASE
        WHEN PV."DocNum" IS NULL
        THEN 'Validar: NF sem vinculo com Pedido de Venda'

        WHEN ENT."Num_Documento_Entrega" IS NOT NULL
        THEN 'OK: NF futura com entrega vinculada'

        ELSE 'OK: NF vinculada ao Pedido de Venda'
    END AS "Status_Vinculo_Pedido",

    CASE
        WHEN LIN."NotaServico" = 'Y'
         AND TRIM(IFNULL(T0."U_MM_NumNFSe", '')) = ''
        THEN 'Validar: NF nao transmitida'

        WHEN LIN."NotaServico" = 'Y'
         AND TRIM(IFNULL(T0."U_MM_NumNFSe", '')) <> ''
        THEN 'OK: NFSe transmitida'

        ELSE 'Nao aplicavel: NF nao e servico'
    END AS "Status_Transmissao_NFSe"

FROM OINV T0

LEFT JOIN OBPL FIL
    ON FIL."BPLId" = T0."BPLId"

LEFT JOIN OPMG PRJ
    ON PRJ."FIPROJECT" = T0."Project"

INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
        X."DocEntryNF",
        X."DocEntryPV",
        X."Departamento",
        X."Utilizacao",
        X."NotaServico"

    FROM (
        SELECT
            I1."DocEntry" AS "DocEntryNF",

            CASE
                WHEN I1."BaseType" = 17
                THEN I1."BaseEntry"
                ELSE NULL
            END AS "DocEntryPV",

            IFNULL(I1."OcrCode", R1."OcrCode") AS "Departamento",

            U."Usage" AS "Utilizacao",

            CASE
                WHEN MAX(
                    CASE
                        WHEN UPPER(IFNULL(I1."ItemCode", '')) LIKE 'SV%'
                        THEN 1
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ) OVER (PARTITION BY I1."DocEntry") = 1
                THEN 'Y'
                ELSE 'N'
            END AS "NotaServico",

            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY I1."DocEntry"
                ORDER BY
                    I1."LineNum"
            ) AS "LinhaControle"

        FROM INV1 I1

        LEFT JOIN RDR1 R1
            ON I1."BaseType" = 17
            AND I1."BaseEntry" = R1."DocEntry"
            AND I1."BaseLine" = R1."LineNum"

        LEFT JOIN OUSG U
            ON U."ID" = I1."Usage"

        WHERE
            IFNULL(I1."OcrCode", R1."OcrCode") IN (
                'GERADOR',
                'NOBREAK',
                'LOCACAO',
                'EXE_ELET',
                'FOTOV',
                'REV_DIRE',
                'SEMINOVO'
            )

            AND IFNULL(I1."TaxOnly", 'N') <> 'Y'
            AND IFNULL(U."TaxOnly", 'N') <> 'Y'
    ) X

    WHERE
        X."LinhaControle" = 1
) LIN
    ON LIN."DocEntryNF" = T0."DocEntry"

LEFT JOIN ORDR PV
    ON PV."DocEntry" = LIN."DocEntryPV"

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        X."DocEntryNFOrigem",
        X."Num_Interno_Entrega",
        X."Num_Documento_Entrega",
        X."Data_Entrega",
        X."Valor_Entrega"

    FROM (
        SELECT
            D1."BaseEntry" AS "DocEntryNFOrigem",
            E0."DocEntry" AS "Num_Interno_Entrega",
            E0."DocNum" AS "Num_Documento_Entrega",
            E0."DocDate" AS "Data_Entrega",
            E0."DocTotal" AS "Valor_Entrega",

            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY D1."BaseEntry"
                ORDER BY
                    E0."DocDate" DESC,
                    E0."DocNum" DESC
            ) AS "LinhaControle"

        FROM ODLN E0

        INNER JOIN DLN1 D1
            ON D1."DocEntry" = E0."DocEntry"

        WHERE
            D1."BaseType" = 13
            AND E0."CANCELED" = 'N'
    ) X

    WHERE
        X."LinhaControle" = 1
) ENT
    ON ENT."DocEntryNFOrigem" = T0."DocEntry"

WHERE
    CASE
        WHEN ENT."Data_Entrega" IS NOT NULL
        THEN ENT."Data_Entrega"
        ELSE T0."DocDate"
    END BETWEEN '[%0]' AND '[%1]'

    AND T0."CANCELED" = 'N'

    AND (
        ENT."Num_Documento_Entrega" IS NOT NULL
        OR (
            UPPER(IFNULL(LIN."Utilizacao", '')) NOT LIKE '%ENTR. FUTURA%'
            AND UPPER(IFNULL(LIN."Utilizacao", '')) NOT LIKE '%ENTREGA FUTURA%'
        )
    )

ORDER BY
    "Data_Referencia_Faturamento" DESC,
    T0."DocNum";
```

Teste primeiro clicando na seta da coluna `Projeto_Gerencial`. Se abrir a tela de `Gerenciamento de projetos > Projeto`, fechamos. Causa técnica: existem projetos financeiros ligados a mais de um projeto gerencial na `OPMG`. Então este join:

Para corrigir, precisamos transformar o `JOIN OPMG` em um vínculo único por `FIPROJECT`, usando `ROW_NUMBER()` e trazendo apenas um projeto gerencial por projeto financeiro.

```sql

        P."DocNum",

    FROM (

                ORDER BY
```

- trazer nome dos depósitos, não só código;
- trazer usuário criador;
- trazer parceiro de negócio, se houver;
- trazer filial;
- trazer status em texto;
- trazer total do pedido de transferência;
- trazer observações;
- trazer OS vinculada, pelo campo que já mapeamos antes: `T0."U_MM_OS"`.

Versão revisada:

```sql
SELECT
    T0."DocEntry" AS "Chave interna do documento",
    T0."DocNum" AS "Nº do documento",

    CASE
        WHEN T0."DocStatus" = 'O' THEN 'Aberto'
        WHEN T0."DocStatus" = 'C' THEN 'Fechado'
        ELSE T0."DocStatus"
    END AS "Status Documento",

    T0."DocDate" AS "Data de lançamento",
    T0."DocDueDate" AS "Data de vencimento",
    T0."TaxDate" AS "Data do documento",

    CASE
        WHEN UPPER(IFNULL(BPL."BPLName", '')) LIKE '%ENGENHARIA%'
        THEN 'Sistel Engenharia'

        WHEN UPPER(IFNULL(BPL."BPLName", '')) LIKE '%COMERCIO%'
          OR UPPER(IFNULL(BPL."BPLName", '')) LIKE '%COMÉRCIO%'
        THEN 'Sistel Comercio'

        ELSE IFNULL(BPL."BPLName", 'Nao Definido')
    END AS "Filial",

    T0."CardCode" AS "Código PN",
    T0."CardName" AS "Nome PN",

    T0."Filler" AS "Código depósito origem",
    DPO."WhsName" AS "Depósito origem",

    T0."ToWhsCode" AS "Código depósito destino",
    DPD."WhsName" AS "Depósito destino",

    T0."U_MM_OS" AS "Ordem de Serviço",

    OS."subject" AS "Assunto OS",

    CASE
        WHEN OS."status" = -3 THEN 'Aberto'
        WHEN OS."status" = -2 THEN 'Pendente'
        WHEN OS."status" = -1 THEN 'Fechado'
        WHEN OS."status" = 1 THEN 'Aguardando Pecas'
        WHEN OS."status" = 2 THEN 'Encerrado IClass'
        WHEN OS."status" = 3 THEN 'Enviar IClass'
        WHEN OS."status" = 4 THEN 'Enviado IClass'
        WHEN OS."status" = 5 THEN 'Equipamento Parado'
        WHEN OS."status" IS NULL THEN ''
        ELSE 'Nao Definido'
    END AS "Status OS",

    T0."DocTotal" AS "Valor total transferência",

    T1."USER_CODE" AS "Código usuário",
    T1."U_NAME" AS "Nome usuário",

    T0."Comments" AS "Observações",
    CAST(SUBSTRING(T0."U_MM_OBS_INTERNO", 1, 254) AS NVARCHAR(254)) AS "Observações internas"

FROM OWTQ T0

INNER JOIN OUSR T1
    ON T0."UserSign" = T1."USERID"

LEFT JOIN OWHS DPO
    ON DPO."WhsCode" = T0."Filler"

LEFT JOIN OWHS DPD
    ON DPD."WhsCode" = T0."ToWhsCode"

LEFT JOIN OBPL BPL
    ON BPL."BPLId" = T0."BPLId"

LEFT JOIN OSCL OS
    ON OS."callID" = T0."U_MM_OS"

WHERE
    T0."DocStatus" = 'O'
    AND T1."USERID" = 11

ORDER BY
    T0."DocDueDate",
    T0."DocNum";
```

Ponto de atenção: se der erro em `T0."U_MM_OS"` ou `T0."U_MM_OBS_INTERNO"`, é porque o campo pode estar com outro nome na sua base/versão. Mas pelo que já mapeamos antes, esses são os nomes que estavam aparecendo nos pedidos de transferência.

## Mensagem 658 | assistant | 09/04/2026 17:29:01

Perfeito, Danilo. Abaixo está uma primeira versão operacional da query de Pedido de Transferência de Estoque, sem limitar por usuário, trazendo as principais informações:

- Nº do pedido de transferência
- Nº da OS
- Parceiro de negócio

- Projeto

- Itens e valores por linha

Mantive o filtro da query padrão para trazer somente pedidos em aberto. Se quiser todos, inclusive fechados, é só remover a linha `T0."DocStatus" = 'O'`.

```sql
SELECT
    T0."DocEntry" AS "Chave Interna do Documento",
    T0."DocNum"   AS "Numero Pedido Transferencia",

    CASE
        WHEN T0."DocStatus" = 'O' THEN 'Aberto'
        WHEN T0."DocStatus" = 'C' THEN 'Fechado'
        ELSE T0."DocStatus"
    END AS "Status Documento",

    CASE
        WHEN T0."CANCELED" = 'Y' THEN 'Sim'
        ELSE 'Nao'
    END AS "Cancelado",

    T0."DocDate"    AS "Data Lancamento",
    T0."DocDueDate" AS "Data Vencimento",
    T0."TaxDate"    AS "Data Documento",

    T0."CardCode" AS "Codigo Parceiro Negocio",
    T0."CardName" AS "Nome Parceiro Negocio",

    T0."BPLId"   AS "Codigo Filial",
    T0."BPLName" AS "Empresa / Filial",

    T0."U_MM_OS" AS "Numero OS",
    OS."DocNum"  AS "Documento OS",
    OS."subject" AS "Assunto OS",

    CASE
        WHEN OS."status" = -3 THEN 'Aberto'
        WHEN OS."status" = -2 THEN 'Pendente'
        WHEN OS."status" = -1 THEN 'Fechado'
        ELSE TO_NVARCHAR(OS."status")
    END AS "Status OS",

    T0."Filler"    AS "Do Deposito",
    WHS_ORIG."WhsName" AS "Nome Do Deposito",

    T0."ToWhsCode" AS "Para Deposito",
    WHS_DEST."WhsName" AS "Nome Para Deposito",

    T1."LineNum" + 1 AS "Linha",
    T1."ItemCode"    AS "Codigo Item",
    T1."Dscription"  AS "Descricao Item",
    T1."Quantity"    AS "Qtd Necessidade",
    T1."Price"       AS "Info Preco",
    T1."LineTotal"   AS "Total Linha",

    T1."Project" AS "Projeto",
    PRJ."PrjName" AS "Nome Projeto",

    T1."OcrCode" AS "Departamento",
    CC."OcrName" AS "Nome Departamento",

    T0."Comments" AS "Observacoes",
    T0."JrnlMemo" AS "Observacoes Diario",

    CAST(SUBSTRING(T0."U_MM_OBS_INTERNO", 1, 254) AS NVARCHAR(254)) AS "Observacoes Internas",

    T0."CreateDate" AS "Data Criacao",
    T0."CreateTS"   AS "Hora Criacao",

    USR_CRIADOR."USER_CODE" AS "Criado por - Codigo Usuario",
    USR_CRIADOR."U_NAME"    AS "Criado por - Nome Usuario",

    T0."UpdateDate" AS "Data Atualizacao",
    T0."UpdateTS"   AS "Hora Atualizacao",

    USR_ATUALIZADOR."USER_CODE" AS "Atualizado por - Codigo Usuario",
    USR_ATUALIZADOR."U_NAME"    AS "Atualizado por - Nome Usuario"

FROM OWTQ T0

INNER JOIN WTQ1 T1
    ON T1."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry"

LEFT JOIN OSCL OS
    ON OS."callID" = T0."U_MM_OS"

LEFT JOIN OWHS WHS_ORIG
    ON WHS_ORIG."WhsCode" = T0."Filler"

LEFT JOIN OWHS WHS_DEST
    ON WHS_DEST."WhsCode" = T0."ToWhsCode"

LEFT JOIN OPRJ PRJ
    ON PRJ."PrjCode" = T1."Project"

LEFT JOIN OOCR CC
    ON CC."OcrCode" = T1."OcrCode"

LEFT JOIN OUSR USR_CRIADOR
    ON USR_CRIADOR."USERID" = T0."UserSign"

LEFT JOIN OUSR USR_ATUALIZADOR
    ON USR_ATUALIZADOR."USERID" = T0."UserSign2"

WHERE
    T0."DocStatus" = 'O'

ORDER BY
    T0."DocDueDate",
    T0."DocNum",
    T1."LineNum";
```

Observação importante: para “Criado por”, usei o campo oficial do próprio documento, `OWTQ."UserSign"`, cruzado com `OUSR`. Ele deve bater com o criador exibido no log. Se você quiser reproduzir exatamente a janela “Log de modificações”, aí o próximo passo é mapear a tabela histórica do objeto `1250000001`, mas para esta primeira versão isso já deve resolver sem complicar a query.

```sql
WITH LINHAS AS (
    SELECT
        L."DocEntry",

        CASE
            WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT IFNULL(L."Project", '')) <= 1 THEN MAX(L."Project")
            ELSE 'MULTIPLOS'
        END AS "Projeto",

        CASE
            WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT IFNULL(L."OcrCode", '')) <= 1 THEN MAX(L."OcrCode")
            ELSE 'MULTIPLOS'
        END AS "Departamento"

    FROM WTQ1 L
    GROUP BY
        L."DocEntry"
)

SELECT
    T0."DocNum" AS "Numero Pedido Transferencia",

    CASE
        WHEN T0."DocStatus" = 'O' THEN 'Aberto'
        WHEN T0."DocStatus" = 'C' THEN 'Fechado'
        ELSE T0."DocStatus"
    END AS "Status Documento",

    CASE
        WHEN T0."CANCELED" = 'Y' THEN 'Sim'
        ELSE 'Nao'
    END AS "Cancelado",

    T0."DocDate"    AS "Data Lancamento",
    T0."DocDueDate" AS "Data Vencimento",
    T0."TaxDate"    AS "Data Documento",

    T0."CardCode" AS "Codigo Parceiro Negocio",
    T0."CardName" AS "Nome Parceiro Negocio",

    CASE
        WHEN UPPER(T0."BPLName") LIKE '%ENGENHARIA%' THEN 'Sistel Engenharia'
        WHEN UPPER(T0."BPLName") LIKE '%COMERCIO%' THEN 'Sistel Comercio'
        ELSE T0."BPLName"
    END AS "Empresa",

    OS."callID" AS "Numero OS",
    OS."subject" AS "Assunto OS",

    CASE
        WHEN OS."status" = -3 THEN 'Aberto'
        WHEN OS."status" = -2 THEN 'Pendente'
        WHEN OS."status" = -1 THEN 'Fechado'
        ELSE TO_NVARCHAR(OS."status")
    END AS "Status OS",

    T0."Filler" AS "Do Deposito",
    WHS_ORIG."WhsName" AS "Nome Do Deposito",

    LINHAS."Projeto",
    PRJ."PrjName" AS "Nome Projeto",

    LINHAS."Departamento",
    CC."OcrName" AS "Nome Departamento",

    T0."DocTotal" AS "Valor Total Pedido Transferencia",

    T0."Comments" AS "Observacoes",
    T0."JrnlMemo" AS "Observacoes Diario",

    CAST(SUBSTRING(T0."U_MM_OBS_INTERNO", 1, 254) AS NVARCHAR(254)) AS "Observacoes Internas",

    T0."CreateDate" AS "Data Criacao",
    T0."CreateTS"   AS "Hora Criacao",

    USR_CRIADOR."U_NAME" AS "Criado por - Nome Usuario"

FROM OWTQ T0

LEFT JOIN LINHAS
    ON LINHAS."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry"

LEFT JOIN OSCL OS
    ON OS."callID" = T0."U_MM_OS"

LEFT JOIN OWHS WHS_ORIG
    ON WHS_ORIG."WhsCode" = T0."Filler"

LEFT JOIN OPRJ PRJ
    ON PRJ."PrjCode" = LINHAS."Projeto"

LEFT JOIN OOCR CC
    ON CC."OcrCode" = LINHAS."Departamento"

LEFT JOIN OUSR USR_CRIADOR
    ON USR_CRIADOR."USERID" = T0."UserSign"

WHERE
    T0."DocStatus" = 'O'

ORDER BY
    T0."DocDueDate",
    T0."DocNum";
```

Ponto importante: coloquei `OS."callID" AS "Numero OS"` para favorecer a seta de acesso ao Chamado de Serviço. Se o SAP não abrir a seta nessa coluna, aí ajustamos para trazer o campo diretamente do `OWTQ."U_MM_OS"`, mas essa versão é a melhor tentativa para navegação pelo objeto da OS.

```sql
    CAST(SUBSTRING(T0."U_MM_OBS_INTERNO", 1, 254) AS NVARCHAR(254)) AS "Observacoes Internas",

    T0."CreateDate" AS "Data Criacao",
    T0."CreateTS"   AS "Hora Criacao"

FROM OWTQ T0

LEFT JOIN LINHAS
    ON LINHAS."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry"

LEFT JOIN OSCL OS
    ON OS."callID" = T0."U_MM_OS"

LEFT JOIN OPRJ PRJ
    ON PRJ."PrjCode" = LINHAS."Projeto"

LEFT JOIN OOCR CC
    ON CC."OcrCode" = LINHAS."Departamento"

LEFT JOIN OUSR USR_CRIADOR
    ON USR_CRIADOR."USERID" = T0."UserSign"

WHERE
    T0."DocStatus" = 'O'

ORDER BY
    T0."DocDueDate",
    T0."DocNum";
```

Esse ajuste mantém o relatório em uma linha por pedido de transferência e traz o item vinculado à OS, não os itens consumidos no pedido.

Ela entra na mesma linha da OS, sem duplicar. O campo de item vem concatenado e a quantidade vem somada.

```sql
WITH TRANSF_HEADER AS (
    SELECT
        TR0."DocEntry" AS "DocEntryTransferencia",
        TR0."DocNum" AS "PedidoTransferencia",
        TR0."DocDate" AS "DataTransferencia",
        TR0."U_MM_OS" AS "NumeroOS",
        TR0."CardCode" AS "CodigoClienteTransferencia",
        TR0."CardName" AS "NomeClienteTransferencia",

        CAST(
            SUBSTRING(TR0."U_MM_OBS_INTERNO", 1, 5000)
            AS NVARCHAR(5000)
        ) AS "ObservacaoInternaTransferencia"

    FROM OWTQ TR0

    WHERE
        TR0."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND TR0."U_MM_OS" IS NOT NULL
),

OS_NUMEROS AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        OS0."callID" AS "NumeroOS"
    FROM OSCL OS0

    UNION

    SELECT DISTINCT
        TH."NumeroOS"
    FROM TRANSF_HEADER TH

    UNION

    SELECT DISTINCT
        PV."U_LOC1_CallID" AS "NumeroOS"
    FROM ORDR PV
    WHERE
        PV."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '4'
        AND PV."U_LOC1_CallID" IS NOT NULL
),

OS_BASE AS (
    SELECT
        O."NumeroOS",

        OS0."DocNum" AS "DocumentoOS",
        OS0."contractID" AS "NumeroContratoLOC1",
        OS0."createDate" AS "DataCriacaoOS",
        OS0."closeDate" AS "DataFechamentoOS",
        OS0."subject" AS "AssuntoOS",

        CASE
            WHEN OS0."status" = -3 THEN 'Aberto'
            WHEN OS0."status" = -2 THEN 'Pendente'
            WHEN OS0."status" = -1 THEN 'Fechado'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 1 THEN 'Aguardando Pecas'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 2 THEN 'Encerrado IClass'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 3 THEN 'Enviar IClass'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 4 THEN 'Enviado IClass'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 5 THEN 'Equipamento Parado'
            WHEN OS0."status" IS NULL THEN ''
            ELSE 'Nao Definido'
        END AS "StatusOS",

        CASE
            WHEN IFNULL(CCOS."OcrName", '') <> ''
            THEN CCOS."OcrName"
            WHEN OS0."U_MM_CC" = '6' THEN 'Gerador'
            WHEN OS0."U_MM_CC" = '7' THEN 'Locacao'
            WHEN OS0."U_MM_CC" = '10' THEN 'Nobreak'
            WHEN OS0."U_MM_CC" = '3' THEN 'Execucao Eletrica'
            WHEN IFNULL(OS0."U_MM_CC", '') = '' THEN ''
            ELSE OS0."U_MM_CC"
        END AS "CentroCustoOS",

        EQ."insID" AS "NumeroCartaoEquipamento",

        IFNULL(EQ."itemCode", OS0."itemCode") AS "CodigoEquipamento",
        IFNULL(EQ."itemName", OS0."itemName") AS "DescricaoEquipamento",
        IFNULL(EQ."manufSN", OS0."manufSN") AS "SerieFabricante",

        IFNULL(EQ."customer", OS0."customer") AS "CodigoCliente",
        IFNULL(EQ."custmrName", OS0."custmrName") AS "NomeCliente",

        CASE
            WHEN EQ."status" = 'A' THEN 'Ativo'
            WHEN EQ."status" = 'T' THEN 'Terminado'
            WHEN EQ."status" = 'R' THEN 'Renovado'
            WHEN EQ."status" = 'L' THEN 'Emprestado'
            WHEN EQ."status" IS NULL THEN ''
            ELSE 'Nao Definido'
        END AS "StatusCartao",

        EQ."U_ICL_Horimeter" AS "HorimetroCartao"

    FROM OS_NUMEROS O

    LEFT JOIN OSCL OS0
        ON OS0."callID" = O."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN OINS EQ
        ON EQ."insID" = OS0."insID"

    LEFT JOIN OOCR CCOS
        ON CCOS."OcrCode" = OS0."U_MM_CC"
),

TRANSF_BASE AS (
    SELECT
        TH."NumeroOS",
        TH."DocEntryTransferencia",
        TH."PedidoTransferencia",
        TH."DataTransferencia",
        TH."CodigoClienteTransferencia",
        TH."NomeClienteTransferencia",
        TH."ObservacaoInternaTransferencia",

        TR1."ItemCode" AS "CodigoMaterial",
        TR1."Dscription" AS "DescricaoMaterial",
        TR1."Quantity" AS "QuantidadeMaterial",
        TR1."LineTotal" AS "ValorMaterialLinha",

        IFNULL(CCTR."OcrName", TR1."OcrCode") AS "CentroCustoTransferencia"

    FROM TRANSF_HEADER TH

    INNER JOIN WTQ1 TR1
        ON TR1."DocEntry" = TH."DocEntryTransferencia"

    LEFT JOIN OOCR CCTR
        ON CCTR."OcrCode" = TR1."OcrCode"
),

TRANSF_DOC_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        D."NumeroOS",
        STRING_AGG(D."PedidoTransferenciaTexto", ', ') AS "PedidosTransferencia",
        MAX(D."DataTransferencia") AS "UltimaDataTransferencia"

    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            TH."NumeroOS",
            TO_VARCHAR(TH."PedidoTransferencia") AS "PedidoTransferenciaTexto",
            TH."DataTransferencia"
        FROM TRANSF_HEADER TH
    ) D

    GROUP BY
        D."NumeroOS"
),

TRANSF_DOC_REF AS (
    SELECT
        X."NumeroOS",
        X."DocEntryTransferencia"

    FROM (
        SELECT
            TH."NumeroOS",
            TH."DocEntryTransferencia",

            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY TH."NumeroOS"
                ORDER BY
                    TH."DataTransferencia" DESC,
                    TH."PedidoTransferencia" DESC
            ) AS "LinhaControle"

        FROM TRANSF_HEADER TH
    ) X

    WHERE
        X."LinhaControle" = 1
),

TRANSF_CLIENTE_RANK AS (
    SELECT
        TH."NumeroOS",
        TH."CodigoClienteTransferencia",
        TH."NomeClienteTransferencia",

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY TH."NumeroOS"
            ORDER BY
                TH."DataTransferencia" DESC,
                TH."PedidoTransferencia" DESC
        ) AS "LinhaControle"

    FROM TRANSF_HEADER TH
),

TRANSF_CLIENTE_UNICO AS (
    SELECT
        T."NumeroOS",
        T."CodigoClienteTransferencia",
        T."NomeClienteTransferencia"

    FROM TRANSF_CLIENTE_RANK T

    WHERE
        T."LinhaControle" = 1
),

TRANSF_MAT_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        M."NumeroOS",
        SUM(M."ValorMaterialLinha") AS "ValorTransferenciaEstoque",
        STRING_AGG(M."MateriaisTexto", ' | ') AS "MateriaisTransferencia"

    FROM (
        SELECT
            TB."NumeroOS",
            TB."ValorMaterialLinha",

            TB."CodigoMaterial"
                || ' - '
                || TB."DescricaoMaterial"
                || ' - Qtd: '
                || TO_VARCHAR(TB."QuantidadeMaterial") AS "MateriaisTexto"

        FROM TRANSF_BASE TB
    ) M

    GROUP BY
        M."NumeroOS"
),

TRANSF_CC_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        C."NumeroOS",
        STRING_AGG(C."CentroCustoTransferencia", ', ') AS "CentroCustoTransferencia"

    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            TB."NumeroOS",
            TB."CentroCustoTransferencia"

        FROM TRANSF_BASE TB

        WHERE
            IFNULL(TB."CentroCustoTransferencia", '') <> ''
    ) C

    GROUP BY
        C."NumeroOS"
),

TRANSF_EQ_CAND AS (
    SELECT
        TH."NumeroOS",

        EQT."insID" AS "NumeroCartaoEquipamento",
        EQT."itemCode" AS "CodigoEquipamento",
        EQT."itemName" AS "DescricaoEquipamento",
        EQT."manufSN" AS "SerieFabricante",
        EQT."customer" AS "CodigoCliente",
        EQT."custmrName" AS "NomeCliente",

        CASE
            WHEN EQT."status" = 'A' THEN 'Ativo'
            WHEN EQT."status" = 'T' THEN 'Terminado'
            WHEN EQT."status" = 'R' THEN 'Renovado'
            WHEN EQT."status" = 'L' THEN 'Emprestado'
            WHEN EQT."status" IS NULL THEN ''
            ELSE 'Nao Definido'
        END AS "StatusCartao",

        EQT."U_ICL_Horimeter" AS "HorimetroCartao",

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY TH."NumeroOS"
            ORDER BY
                EQT."insID"
        ) AS "LinhaControle"

    FROM TRANSF_HEADER TH

    INNER JOIN OINS EQT
        ON UPPER(IFNULL(TH."ObservacaoInternaTransferencia", '')) LIKE
            '%' || UPPER(EQT."itemCode") || '%'
),

TRANSF_EQ_UNICO AS (
    SELECT
        E."NumeroOS",
        E."NumeroCartaoEquipamento",
        E."CodigoEquipamento",
        E."DescricaoEquipamento",
        E."SerieFabricante",
        E."CodigoCliente",
        E."NomeCliente",
        E."StatusCartao",
        E."HorimetroCartao"

    FROM TRANSF_EQ_CAND E

    WHERE
        E."LinhaControle" = 1
),

TRANSF_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        DOC."NumeroOS",
        REF."DocEntryTransferencia" AS "DocEntryTransferenciaRef",
        DOC."PedidosTransferencia",
        DOC."UltimaDataTransferencia",
        IFNULL(MAT."ValorTransferenciaEstoque", 0) AS "ValorTransferenciaEstoque",
        IFNULL(MAT."MateriaisTransferencia", '') AS "MateriaisTransferencia",
        IFNULL(CC."CentroCustoTransferencia", '') AS "CentroCustoTransferencia",
        CLI."CodigoClienteTransferencia",
        CLI."NomeClienteTransferencia"

    FROM TRANSF_DOC_AGR DOC

    LEFT JOIN TRANSF_DOC_REF REF
        ON REF."NumeroOS" = DOC."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN TRANSF_MAT_AGR MAT
        ON MAT."NumeroOS" = DOC."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN TRANSF_CC_AGR CC
        ON CC."NumeroOS" = DOC."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN TRANSF_CLIENTE_UNICO CLI
        ON CLI."NumeroOS" = DOC."NumeroOS"
),

PV_OS_CANDIDATOS AS (
    SELECT
        OSB."NumeroOS",

        PV."DocEntry" AS "DocEntryPedidoVenda",
        PV."DocNum" AS "PedidoVenda",
        PV."DocDate" AS "DataPedidoVenda",
        PV."DocTotal" AS "ValorPedidoVenda",
        PV."CardCode" AS "CodigoClientePedidoVenda",
        PV."CardName" AS "NomeClientePedidoVenda",

        CASE
            WHEN PV."U_LOC1_CallID" = OSB."NumeroOS"
            THEN 1
            ELSE 2
        END AS "PrioridadeVinculo"

    FROM OS_BASE OSB

    INNER JOIN ORDR PV
        ON PV."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '4'
        AND (
            PV."U_LOC1_CallID" = OSB."NumeroOS"

            OR UPPER(IFNULL(PV."Comments", '')) LIKE
                '%CHAMADO DE SERVIÇO ' || TO_VARCHAR(OSB."NumeroOS") || ' (%'

            OR UPPER(IFNULL(PV."Comments", '')) LIKE
                '%CHAMADO DE SERVICO ' || TO_VARCHAR(OSB."NumeroOS") || ' (%'
        )
),

PV_OS_RANK AS (
    SELECT
        P."NumeroOS",
        P."DocEntryPedidoVenda",
        P."PedidoVenda",
        P."DataPedidoVenda",
        P."ValorPedidoVenda",
        P."CodigoClientePedidoVenda",
        P."NomeClientePedidoVenda",

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY P."NumeroOS"
            ORDER BY
                P."PrioridadeVinculo",
                P."DataPedidoVenda" DESC,
                P."PedidoVenda" DESC
        ) AS "LinhaControle"

    FROM PV_OS_CANDIDATOS P
),

PV_OS_UNICO AS (
    SELECT
        P."NumeroOS",
        P."DocEntryPedidoVenda",
        P."PedidoVenda" AS "PedidoVendaGeradoOS",
        P."DataPedidoVenda" AS "DataPedidoVendaGeradoOS",
        P."ValorPedidoVenda" AS "ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS",
        P."CodigoClientePedidoVenda",
        P."NomeClientePedidoVenda"

    FROM PV_OS_RANK P

    WHERE
        P."LinhaControle" = 1
),

PV_SERVICO_FINALIZACAO_BASE AS (
    SELECT
        OSB."NumeroOS",

        PV."DocEntry" AS "DocEntryPedidoServico",
        PV."DocNum" AS "PedidoVendaServico",
        PV."DocDate" AS "DataPedidoServico",

        PV1."ItemCode" AS "CodigoItemServico",
        PV1."Dscription" AS "DescricaoItemServico",
        PV1."Quantity" AS "QuantidadeServico",
        PV1."LineTotal" AS "ValorServicoLinha"

    FROM OS_BASE OSB

    INNER JOIN ORDR PV
        ON PV."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND (
            PV."U_LOC1_CallID" = OSB."NumeroOS"

            OR UPPER(IFNULL(PV."Comments", '')) LIKE
                '%CHAMADO DE SERVIÇO ' || TO_VARCHAR(OSB."NumeroOS") || ' (%'

            OR UPPER(IFNULL(PV."Comments", '')) LIKE
                '%CHAMADO DE SERVICO ' || TO_VARCHAR(OSB."NumeroOS") || ' (%'
        )

    INNER JOIN RDR1 PV1
        ON PV1."DocEntry" = PV."DocEntry"
        AND PV1."ItemCode" IN ('SV000045', 'SV000044')
),

PV_SERVICO_FINALIZACAO_DOC_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        D."NumeroOS",
        STRING_AGG(D."PedidoVendaServicoTexto", ', ') AS "PedidosVendaServicoFinalizacao",
        MAX(D."DataPedidoServico") AS "UltimaDataPedidoServicoFinalizacao"

    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            B."NumeroOS",
            TO_VARCHAR(B."PedidoVendaServico") AS "PedidoVendaServicoTexto",
            B."DataPedidoServico"

        FROM PV_SERVICO_FINALIZACAO_BASE B
    ) D

    GROUP BY
        D."NumeroOS"
),

PV_SERVICO_FINALIZACAO_DOC_REF AS (
    SELECT
        X."NumeroOS",
        X."DocEntryPedidoServico"

    FROM (
        SELECT
            B."NumeroOS",
            B."DocEntryPedidoServico",

            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY B."NumeroOS"
                ORDER BY
                    B."DataPedidoServico" DESC,
                    B."PedidoVendaServico" DESC
            ) AS "LinhaControle"

        FROM (
            SELECT DISTINCT
                P."NumeroOS",
                P."DocEntryPedidoServico",
                P."PedidoVendaServico",
                P."DataPedidoServico"
            FROM PV_SERVICO_FINALIZACAO_BASE P
        ) B
    ) X

    WHERE
        X."LinhaControle" = 1
),

PV_SERVICO_FINALIZACAO_ITENS_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        I."NumeroOS",
        STRING_AGG(I."ItemServicoTexto", ' | ') AS "ItensServicoFinalizacaoOS"

    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            B."NumeroOS",
            B."CodigoItemServico"
                || ' - '
                || B."DescricaoItemServico" AS "ItemServicoTexto"

        FROM PV_SERVICO_FINALIZACAO_BASE B
    ) I

    GROUP BY
        I."NumeroOS"
),

PV_SERVICO_FINALIZACAO_VALOR_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        B."NumeroOS",
        SUM(B."QuantidadeServico") AS "QuantidadeServicoFinalizacaoOS",
        SUM(B."ValorServicoLinha") AS "ValorServicoFinalizacaoOS"

    FROM PV_SERVICO_FINALIZACAO_BASE B

    GROUP BY
        B."NumeroOS"
),

PV_SERVICO_FINALIZACAO_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        DOC."NumeroOS",
        REF."DocEntryPedidoServico" AS "DocEntryPedidoServicoRef",
        DOC."PedidosVendaServicoFinalizacao",
        DOC."UltimaDataPedidoServicoFinalizacao",
        IFNULL(IT."ItensServicoFinalizacaoOS", '') AS "ItensServicoFinalizacaoOS",
        IFNULL(VAL."QuantidadeServicoFinalizacaoOS", 0) AS "QuantidadeServicoFinalizacaoOS",
        IFNULL(VAL."ValorServicoFinalizacaoOS", 0) AS "ValorServicoFinalizacaoOS"

    FROM PV_SERVICO_FINALIZACAO_DOC_AGR DOC

    LEFT JOIN PV_SERVICO_FINALIZACAO_DOC_REF REF
        ON REF."NumeroOS" = DOC."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN PV_SERVICO_FINALIZACAO_ITENS_AGR IT
        ON IT."NumeroOS" = DOC."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN PV_SERVICO_FINALIZACAO_VALOR_AGR VAL
        ON VAL."NumeroOS" = DOC."NumeroOS"
),

RELATORIO AS (
    SELECT
        OSB."NumeroContratoLOC1",

        IFNULL(OSB."NumeroCartaoEquipamento", TEQ."NumeroCartaoEquipamento") AS "NumeroCartaoEquipamento",
        IFNULL(OSB."CodigoEquipamento", TEQ."CodigoEquipamento") AS "CodigoEquipamento",
        IFNULL(OSB."DescricaoEquipamento", TEQ."DescricaoEquipamento") AS "DescricaoEquipamento",
        IFNULL(OSB."SerieFabricante", TEQ."SerieFabricante") AS "SerieFabricante",

        IFNULL(
            IFNULL(OSB."CodigoCliente", TEQ."CodigoCliente"),
            IFNULL(TRF."CodigoClienteTransferencia", PVG."CodigoClientePedidoVenda")
        ) AS "CodigoCliente",

        IFNULL(
            IFNULL(OSB."NomeCliente", TEQ."NomeCliente"),
            IFNULL(TRF."NomeClienteTransferencia", PVG."NomeClientePedidoVenda")
        ) AS "NomeCliente",

        IFNULL(OSB."StatusCartao", TEQ."StatusCartao") AS "StatusCartao",
        IFNULL(OSB."HorimetroCartao", TEQ."HorimetroCartao") AS "HorimetroCartao",

        OSB."NumeroOS",
        OSB."DocumentoOS",
        OSB."DataCriacaoOS",
        OSB."DataFechamentoOS",

        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN LENGTH(IFNULL(OSB."AssuntoOS", '')) > 120
                THEN SUBSTRING(OSB."AssuntoOS", 1, 120) || '...'
                ELSE IFNULL(OSB."AssuntoOS", '')
            END
            AS NVARCHAR(123)
        ) AS "AssuntoOS",

        OSB."StatusOS",

        CASE
            WHEN IFNULL(OSB."CentroCustoOS", '') <> ''
            THEN OSB."CentroCustoOS"

            WHEN IFNULL(TRF."CentroCustoTransferencia", '') <> ''
            THEN TRF."CentroCustoTransferencia"

            ELSE ''
        END AS "CentroCustoOS",

        TRF."DocEntryTransferenciaRef",
        IFNULL(TRF."PedidosTransferencia", '') AS "PedidosTransferencia",
        TRF."UltimaDataTransferencia",
        IFNULL(TRF."ValorTransferenciaEstoque", 0) AS "ValorTransferenciaEstoque",
        IFNULL(TRF."MateriaisTransferencia", '') AS "MateriaisTransferencia",

        PVG."DocEntryPedidoVenda",
        PVG."PedidoVendaGeradoOS",
        PVG."DataPedidoVendaGeradoOS",
        IFNULL(PVG."ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS", 0) AS "ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS",

        PVS."DocEntryPedidoServicoRef",
        IFNULL(PVS."PedidosVendaServicoFinalizacao", '') AS "PedidosVendaServicoFinalizacao",
        PVS."UltimaDataPedidoServicoFinalizacao",
        IFNULL(PVS."ItensServicoFinalizacaoOS", '') AS "ItensServicoFinalizacaoOS",
        IFNULL(PVS."QuantidadeServicoFinalizacaoOS", 0) AS "QuantidadeServicoFinalizacaoOS",
        IFNULL(PVS."ValorServicoFinalizacaoOS", 0) AS "ValorServicoFinalizacaoOS",

        (
            IFNULL(TRF."ValorTransferenciaEstoque", 0)
            +
            IFNULL(PVG."ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS", 0)
            +
            IFNULL(PVS."ValorServicoFinalizacaoOS", 0)
        ) AS "CustoTotalOS"

    FROM OS_BASE OSB

    LEFT JOIN TRANSF_AGR TRF
        ON TRF."NumeroOS" = OSB."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN TRANSF_EQ_UNICO TEQ
        ON TEQ."NumeroOS" = OSB."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN PV_OS_UNICO PVG
        ON PVG."NumeroOS" = OSB."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN PV_SERVICO_FINALIZACAO_AGR PVS
        ON PVS."NumeroOS" = OSB."NumeroOS"
)

SELECT
    CT_LINK."ContractID" AS "Numero Contrato LOC1",

    EQ_LINK."insID" AS "Numero Cartao Equipamento",
    ITEM_LINK."ItemCode" AS "Codigo Equipamento",
    ITEM_LINK."ItemName" AS "Descricao Equipamento",
    R."SerieFabricante" AS "Serie Fabricante",

    BP_LINK."CardCode" AS "Codigo Cliente",
    BP_LINK."CardName" AS "Nome Cliente",

    R."StatusCartao" AS "Status Cartao",
    R."HorimetroCartao" AS "Horimetro Cartao",

    OS_LINK."callID" AS "Numero OS",
    OS_LINK."DocNum" AS "Documento OS",
    R."DataCriacaoOS" AS "Data Criacao OS",
    R."DataFechamentoOS" AS "Data Fechamento OS",
    R."AssuntoOS" AS "Assunto OS",
    R."StatusOS" AS "Status OS",
    R."CentroCustoOS" AS "Centro Custo OS",

    TR_LINK."DocNum" AS "Pedido Transferencia Ref",
    R."PedidosTransferencia" AS "Pedidos Transferencia",
    R."UltimaDataTransferencia" AS "Ultima Data Transferencia",
    R."ValorTransferenciaEstoque" AS "Valor Transferencia Estoque",
    R."MateriaisTransferencia" AS "Materiais Transferencia",

    PV_LINK."DocNum" AS "Pedido Venda Gerado OS",
    R."DataPedidoVendaGeradoOS" AS "Data Pedido Venda Gerado OS",
    R."ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS" AS "Valor Pedido Venda Gerado OS",

    PV_SERV_LINK."DocNum" AS "Pedido Venda Servico Finalizacao Ref",
    R."PedidosVendaServicoFinalizacao" AS "Pedidos Venda Servico Finalizacao",
    R."UltimaDataPedidoServicoFinalizacao" AS "Ultima Data Pedido Servico Finalizacao",
    R."ItensServicoFinalizacaoOS" AS "Itens Servico Finalizacao OS",
    R."QuantidadeServicoFinalizacaoOS" AS "Quantidade Minutos Servico Finalizacao",
    R."ValorServicoFinalizacaoOS" AS "Valor Servico Finalizacao OS",

    R."CustoTotalOS" AS "Custo Total OS",

    CASE
        WHEN R."ValorTransferenciaEstoque" = 0
         AND R."ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS" = 0
         AND R."ValorServicoFinalizacaoOS" = 0
        THEN 'Sem custo vinculado'

        WHEN R."ValorTransferenciaEstoque" > 0
         AND R."ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS" > 0
         AND R."ValorServicoFinalizacaoOS" > 0
        THEN 'Custo por transferencia, pedido gerado por OS e servico finalizacao iClass'

        WHEN R."ValorTransferenciaEstoque" > 0
         AND R."ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS" > 0
        THEN 'Custo por transferencia e pedido gerado por OS'

        WHEN R."ValorTransferenciaEstoque" > 0
         AND R."ValorServicoFinalizacaoOS" > 0
        THEN 'Custo por transferencia e servico finalizacao iClass'

        WHEN R."ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS" > 0
         AND R."ValorServicoFinalizacaoOS" > 0
        THEN 'Custo por pedido gerado por OS e servico finalizacao iClass'

        WHEN R."ValorTransferenciaEstoque" > 0
        THEN 'Custo por transferencia de estoque'

        WHEN R."ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS" > 0
        THEN 'Custo por pedido de venda gerado por OS'

        WHEN R."ValorServicoFinalizacaoOS" > 0
        THEN 'Custo por servico finalizacao iClass'

        ELSE 'Validar'
    END AS "Origem Custo OS"

FROM RELATORIO R

LEFT JOIN OCTR CT_LINK
    ON CT_LINK."ContractID" = R."NumeroContratoLOC1"

LEFT JOIN OINS EQ_LINK
    ON EQ_LINK."insID" = R."NumeroCartaoEquipamento"

LEFT JOIN OITM ITEM_LINK
    ON ITEM_LINK."ItemCode" = R."CodigoEquipamento"

LEFT JOIN OCRD BP_LINK
    ON BP_LINK."CardCode" = R."CodigoCliente"

LEFT JOIN OSCL OS_LINK
    ON OS_LINK."callID" = R."NumeroOS"

LEFT JOIN OWTQ TR_LINK
    ON TR_LINK."DocEntry" = R."DocEntryTransferenciaRef"

LEFT JOIN ORDR PV_LINK
    ON PV_LINK."DocEntry" = R."DocEntryPedidoVenda"

LEFT JOIN ORDR PV_SERV_LINK
    ON PV_SERV_LINK."DocEntry" = R."DocEntryPedidoServicoRef"

ORDER BY
    BP_LINK."CardName",
    ITEM_LINK."ItemCode",
    EQ_LINK."insID",
    OS_LINK."callID";
```

A melhoria principal está nesta nova parte: `PV_SERVICO_FINALIZACAO_*`. Ela localiza pedidos de venda vinculados à OS e soma somente as linhas dos itens `SV000045` e `SV000044`, sem criar novas linhas no relatório.

Ajustei para usar:

```sql
SCL4."SrcvCallID" = Numero da OS

```

E renomeei essa origem como `PV Gerado por iClass`.

Substitua a query pela versão abaixo:

```sql
WITH TRANSF_HEADER AS (
    SELECT
        TR0."DocEntry" AS "DocEntryTransferencia",
        TR0."DocNum" AS "PedidoTransferencia",
        TR0."DocDate" AS "DataTransferencia",
        TR0."U_MM_OS" AS "NumeroOS",
        TR0."CardCode" AS "CodigoClienteTransferencia",
        TR0."CardName" AS "NomeClienteTransferencia",

        CAST(
            SUBSTRING(TR0."U_MM_OBS_INTERNO", 1, 5000)
            AS NVARCHAR(5000)
        ) AS "ObservacaoInternaTransferencia"

    FROM OWTQ TR0

    WHERE
        TR0."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND TR0."U_MM_OS" IS NOT NULL
),

OS_NUMEROS AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        OS0."callID" AS "NumeroOS"
    FROM OSCL OS0

    UNION

    SELECT DISTINCT
        TH."NumeroOS"
    FROM TRANSF_HEADER TH

    UNION

    SELECT DISTINCT
        PV."U_LOC1_CallID" AS "NumeroOS"
    FROM ORDR PV
    WHERE
        PV."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '4'
        AND PV."U_LOC1_CallID" IS NOT NULL

    UNION

    SELECT DISTINCT
        S4."SrcvCallID" AS "NumeroOS"
    FROM SCL4 S4
    INNER JOIN ORDR PV
        ON PV."DocEntry" = S4."DocAbs"
        AND PV."CANCELED" = 'N'
    INNER JOIN RDR1 PV1
        ON PV1."DocEntry" = PV."DocEntry"
        AND PV1."ItemCode" IN ('SV000045', 'SV000044')
    WHERE
        S4."Object" = '17'
),

OS_BASE AS (
    SELECT
        O."NumeroOS",

        OS0."DocNum" AS "DocumentoOS",
        OS0."contractID" AS "NumeroContratoLOC1",
        OS0."createDate" AS "DataCriacaoOS",
        OS0."closeDate" AS "DataFechamentoOS",
        OS0."subject" AS "AssuntoOS",

        CASE
            WHEN OS0."status" = -3 THEN 'Aberto'
            WHEN OS0."status" = -2 THEN 'Pendente'
            WHEN OS0."status" = -1 THEN 'Fechado'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 1 THEN 'Aguardando Pecas'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 2 THEN 'Encerrado IClass'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 3 THEN 'Enviar IClass'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 4 THEN 'Enviado IClass'
            WHEN OS0."status" = 5 THEN 'Equipamento Parado'
            WHEN OS0."status" IS NULL THEN ''
            ELSE 'Nao Definido'
        END AS "StatusOS",

        CASE
            WHEN IFNULL(CCOS."OcrName", '') <> ''
            THEN CCOS."OcrName"
            WHEN OS0."U_MM_CC" = '6' THEN 'Gerador'
            WHEN OS0."U_MM_CC" = '7' THEN 'Locacao'
            WHEN OS0."U_MM_CC" = '10' THEN 'Nobreak'
            WHEN OS0."U_MM_CC" = '3' THEN 'Execucao Eletrica'
            WHEN IFNULL(OS0."U_MM_CC", '') = '' THEN ''
            ELSE OS0."U_MM_CC"
        END AS "CentroCustoOS",

        EQ."insID" AS "NumeroCartaoEquipamento",

        IFNULL(EQ."itemCode", OS0."itemCode") AS "CodigoEquipamento",
        IFNULL(EQ."itemName", OS0."itemName") AS "DescricaoEquipamento",
        IFNULL(EQ."manufSN", OS0."manufSN") AS "SerieFabricante",

        IFNULL(EQ."customer", OS0."customer") AS "CodigoCliente",
        IFNULL(EQ."custmrName", OS0."custmrName") AS "NomeCliente",

        CASE
            WHEN EQ."status" = 'A' THEN 'Ativo'
            WHEN EQ."status" = 'T' THEN 'Terminado'
            WHEN EQ."status" = 'R' THEN 'Renovado'
            WHEN EQ."status" = 'L' THEN 'Emprestado'
            WHEN EQ."status" IS NULL THEN ''
            ELSE 'Nao Definido'
        END AS "StatusCartao",

        EQ."U_ICL_Horimeter" AS "HorimetroCartao"

    FROM OS_NUMEROS O

    LEFT JOIN OSCL OS0
        ON OS0."callID" = O."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN OINS EQ
        ON EQ."insID" = OS0."insID"

    LEFT JOIN OOCR CCOS
        ON CCOS."OcrCode" = OS0."U_MM_CC"
),

TRANSF_BASE AS (
    SELECT
        TH."NumeroOS",
        TH."DocEntryTransferencia",
        TH."PedidoTransferencia",
        TH."DataTransferencia",
        TH."CodigoClienteTransferencia",
        TH."NomeClienteTransferencia",
        TH."ObservacaoInternaTransferencia",

        TR1."ItemCode" AS "CodigoMaterial",
        TR1."Dscription" AS "DescricaoMaterial",
        TR1."Quantity" AS "QuantidadeMaterial",
        TR1."LineTotal" AS "ValorMaterialLinha",

        IFNULL(CCTR."OcrName", TR1."OcrCode") AS "CentroCustoTransferencia"

    FROM TRANSF_HEADER TH

    INNER JOIN WTQ1 TR1
        ON TR1."DocEntry" = TH."DocEntryTransferencia"

    LEFT JOIN OOCR CCTR
        ON CCTR."OcrCode" = TR1."OcrCode"
),

TRANSF_DOC_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        D."NumeroOS",
        STRING_AGG(D."PedidoTransferenciaTexto", ', ') AS "PedidosTransferencia",
        MAX(D."DataTransferencia") AS "UltimaDataTransferencia"

    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            TH."NumeroOS",
            TO_VARCHAR(TH."PedidoTransferencia") AS "PedidoTransferenciaTexto",
            TH."DataTransferencia"
        FROM TRANSF_HEADER TH
    ) D

    GROUP BY
        D."NumeroOS"
),

TRANSF_DOC_REF AS (
    SELECT
        X."NumeroOS",
        X."DocEntryTransferencia"

    FROM (
        SELECT
            TH."NumeroOS",
            TH."DocEntryTransferencia",

            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY TH."NumeroOS"
                ORDER BY
                    TH."DataTransferencia" DESC,
                    TH."PedidoTransferencia" DESC
            ) AS "LinhaControle"

        FROM TRANSF_HEADER TH
    ) X

    WHERE
        X."LinhaControle" = 1
),

TRANSF_CLIENTE_RANK AS (
    SELECT
        TH."NumeroOS",
        TH."CodigoClienteTransferencia",
        TH."NomeClienteTransferencia",

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY TH."NumeroOS"
            ORDER BY
                TH."DataTransferencia" DESC,
                TH."PedidoTransferencia" DESC
        ) AS "LinhaControle"

    FROM TRANSF_HEADER TH
),

TRANSF_CLIENTE_UNICO AS (
    SELECT
        T."NumeroOS",
        T."CodigoClienteTransferencia",
        T."NomeClienteTransferencia"

    FROM TRANSF_CLIENTE_RANK T

    WHERE
        T."LinhaControle" = 1
),

TRANSF_MAT_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        M."NumeroOS",
        SUM(M."ValorMaterialLinha") AS "ValorTransferenciaEstoque",
        STRING_AGG(M."MateriaisTexto", ' | ') AS "MateriaisTransferencia"

    FROM (
        SELECT
            TB."NumeroOS",
            TB."ValorMaterialLinha",

            TB."CodigoMaterial"
                || ' - '
                || TB."DescricaoMaterial"
                || ' - Qtd: '
                || TO_VARCHAR(TB."QuantidadeMaterial") AS "MateriaisTexto"

        FROM TRANSF_BASE TB
    ) M

    GROUP BY
        M."NumeroOS"
),

TRANSF_CC_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        C."NumeroOS",
        STRING_AGG(C."CentroCustoTransferencia", ', ') AS "CentroCustoTransferencia"

    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            TB."NumeroOS",
            TB."CentroCustoTransferencia"

        FROM TRANSF_BASE TB

        WHERE
            IFNULL(TB."CentroCustoTransferencia", '') <> ''
    ) C

    GROUP BY
        C."NumeroOS"
),

TRANSF_EQ_CAND AS (
    SELECT
        TH."NumeroOS",

        EQT."insID" AS "NumeroCartaoEquipamento",
        EQT."itemCode" AS "CodigoEquipamento",
        EQT."itemName" AS "DescricaoEquipamento",
        EQT."manufSN" AS "SerieFabricante",
        EQT."customer" AS "CodigoCliente",
        EQT."custmrName" AS "NomeCliente",

        CASE
            WHEN EQT."status" = 'A' THEN 'Ativo'
            WHEN EQT."status" = 'T' THEN 'Terminado'
            WHEN EQT."status" = 'R' THEN 'Renovado'
            WHEN EQT."status" = 'L' THEN 'Emprestado'
            WHEN EQT."status" IS NULL THEN ''
            ELSE 'Nao Definido'
        END AS "StatusCartao",

        EQT."U_ICL_Horimeter" AS "HorimetroCartao",

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY TH."NumeroOS"
            ORDER BY
                EQT."insID"
        ) AS "LinhaControle"

    FROM TRANSF_HEADER TH

    INNER JOIN OINS EQT
        ON UPPER(IFNULL(TH."ObservacaoInternaTransferencia", '')) LIKE
            '%' || UPPER(EQT."itemCode") || '%'
),

TRANSF_EQ_UNICO AS (
    SELECT
        E."NumeroOS",
        E."NumeroCartaoEquipamento",
        E."CodigoEquipamento",
        E."DescricaoEquipamento",
        E."SerieFabricante",
        E."CodigoCliente",
        E."NomeCliente",
        E."StatusCartao",
        E."HorimetroCartao"

    FROM TRANSF_EQ_CAND E

    WHERE
        E."LinhaControle" = 1
),

TRANSF_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        DOC."NumeroOS",
        REF."DocEntryTransferencia" AS "DocEntryTransferenciaRef",
        DOC."PedidosTransferencia",
        DOC."UltimaDataTransferencia",
        IFNULL(MAT."ValorTransferenciaEstoque", 0) AS "ValorTransferenciaEstoque",
        IFNULL(MAT."MateriaisTransferencia", '') AS "MateriaisTransferencia",
        IFNULL(CC."CentroCustoTransferencia", '') AS "CentroCustoTransferencia",
        CLI."CodigoClienteTransferencia",
        CLI."NomeClienteTransferencia"

    FROM TRANSF_DOC_AGR DOC

    LEFT JOIN TRANSF_DOC_REF REF
        ON REF."NumeroOS" = DOC."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN TRANSF_MAT_AGR MAT
        ON MAT."NumeroOS" = DOC."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN TRANSF_CC_AGR CC
        ON CC."NumeroOS" = DOC."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN TRANSF_CLIENTE_UNICO CLI
        ON CLI."NumeroOS" = DOC."NumeroOS"
),

PV_OS_CANDIDATOS AS (
    SELECT
        OSB."NumeroOS",

        PV."DocEntry" AS "DocEntryPedidoVenda",
        PV."DocNum" AS "PedidoVenda",
        PV."DocDate" AS "DataPedidoVenda",
        PV."DocTotal" AS "ValorPedidoVenda",
        PV."CardCode" AS "CodigoClientePedidoVenda",
        PV."CardName" AS "NomeClientePedidoVenda",

        CASE
            WHEN PV."U_LOC1_CallID" = OSB."NumeroOS"
            THEN 1
            ELSE 2
        END AS "PrioridadeVinculo"

    FROM OS_BASE OSB

    INNER JOIN ORDR PV
        ON PV."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND PV."U_MM_Tipo" = '4'
        AND (
            PV."U_LOC1_CallID" = OSB."NumeroOS"

            OR UPPER(IFNULL(PV."Comments", '')) LIKE
                '%CHAMADO DE SERVIÇO ' || TO_VARCHAR(OSB."NumeroOS") || ' (%'

            OR UPPER(IFNULL(PV."Comments", '')) LIKE
                '%CHAMADO DE SERVICO ' || TO_VARCHAR(OSB."NumeroOS") || ' (%'
        )
),

PV_OS_RANK AS (
    SELECT
        P."NumeroOS",
        P."DocEntryPedidoVenda",
        P."PedidoVenda",
        P."DataPedidoVenda",
        P."ValorPedidoVenda",
        P."CodigoClientePedidoVenda",
        P."NomeClientePedidoVenda",

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY P."NumeroOS"
            ORDER BY
                P."PrioridadeVinculo",
                P."DataPedidoVenda" DESC,
                P."PedidoVenda" DESC
        ) AS "LinhaControle"

    FROM PV_OS_CANDIDATOS P
),

PV_OS_UNICO AS (
    SELECT
        P."NumeroOS",
        P."DocEntryPedidoVenda",
        P."PedidoVenda" AS "PedidoVendaGeradoOS",
        P."DataPedidoVenda" AS "DataPedidoVendaGeradoOS",
        P."ValorPedidoVenda" AS "ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS",
        P."CodigoClientePedidoVenda",
        P."NomeClientePedidoVenda"

    FROM PV_OS_RANK P

    WHERE
        P."LinhaControle" = 1
),

PV_ICLASS_BASE AS (
    SELECT
        S4."SrcvCallID" AS "NumeroOS",

        PV."DocEntry" AS "DocEntryPVGeradoIClass",
        PV."DocNum" AS "PVGeradoIClass",
        PV."DocDate" AS "DataPVGeradoIClass",

        PV1."ItemCode" AS "CodigoItemIClass",
        PV1."Dscription" AS "DescricaoItemIClass",
        PV1."Quantity" AS "QuantidadeIClass",
        PV1."LineTotal" AS "ValorLinhaIClass"

    FROM SCL4 S4

    INNER JOIN ORDR PV
        ON PV."DocEntry" = S4."DocAbs"
        AND PV."CANCELED" = 'N'

    INNER JOIN RDR1 PV1
        ON PV1."DocEntry" = PV."DocEntry"
        AND PV1."ItemCode" IN ('SV000045', 'SV000044')

    WHERE
        S4."Object" = '17'
),

PV_ICLASS_DOC_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        D."NumeroOS",
        STRING_AGG(D."PVGeradoIClassTexto", ', ') AS "PVsGeradosIClass",
        MAX(D."DataPVGeradoIClass") AS "UltimaDataPVGeradoIClass"

    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            B."NumeroOS",
            TO_VARCHAR(B."PVGeradoIClass") AS "PVGeradoIClassTexto",
            B."DataPVGeradoIClass"
        FROM PV_ICLASS_BASE B
    ) D

    GROUP BY
        D."NumeroOS"
),

PV_ICLASS_DOC_REF AS (
    SELECT
        X."NumeroOS",
        X."DocEntryPVGeradoIClass"

    FROM (
        SELECT
            B."NumeroOS",
            B."DocEntryPVGeradoIClass",

            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY B."NumeroOS"
                ORDER BY
                    B."DataPVGeradoIClass" DESC,
                    B."PVGeradoIClass" DESC
            ) AS "LinhaControle"

        FROM (
            SELECT DISTINCT
                P."NumeroOS",
                P."DocEntryPVGeradoIClass",
                P."PVGeradoIClass",
                P."DataPVGeradoIClass"
            FROM PV_ICLASS_BASE P
        ) B
    ) X

    WHERE
        X."LinhaControle" = 1
),

PV_ICLASS_ITEM_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        I."NumeroOS",
        STRING_AGG(I."ItemIClassTexto", ' | ') AS "ItensPVGeradoIClass"

    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            B."NumeroOS",
            B."CodigoItemIClass"
                || ' - '
                || B."DescricaoItemIClass" AS "ItemIClassTexto"

        FROM PV_ICLASS_BASE B
    ) I

    GROUP BY
        I."NumeroOS"
),

PV_ICLASS_VALOR_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        B."NumeroOS",
        SUM(B."QuantidadeIClass") AS "QuantidadePVGeradoIClass",
        SUM(B."ValorLinhaIClass") AS "ValorPVGeradoIClass"

    FROM PV_ICLASS_BASE B

    GROUP BY
        B."NumeroOS"
),

PV_ICLASS_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        DOC."NumeroOS",
        REF."DocEntryPVGeradoIClass" AS "DocEntryPVGeradoIClassRef",
        DOC."PVsGeradosIClass",
        DOC."UltimaDataPVGeradoIClass",
        IFNULL(IT."ItensPVGeradoIClass", '') AS "ItensPVGeradoIClass",
        IFNULL(VAL."QuantidadePVGeradoIClass", 0) AS "QuantidadePVGeradoIClass",
        IFNULL(VAL."ValorPVGeradoIClass", 0) AS "ValorPVGeradoIClass"

    FROM PV_ICLASS_DOC_AGR DOC

    LEFT JOIN PV_ICLASS_DOC_REF REF
        ON REF."NumeroOS" = DOC."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN PV_ICLASS_ITEM_AGR IT
        ON IT."NumeroOS" = DOC."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN PV_ICLASS_VALOR_AGR VAL
        ON VAL."NumeroOS" = DOC."NumeroOS"
),

RELATORIO AS (
    SELECT
        OSB."NumeroContratoLOC1",

        IFNULL(OSB."NumeroCartaoEquipamento", TEQ."NumeroCartaoEquipamento") AS "NumeroCartaoEquipamento",
        IFNULL(OSB."CodigoEquipamento", TEQ."CodigoEquipamento") AS "CodigoEquipamento",
        IFNULL(OSB."DescricaoEquipamento", TEQ."DescricaoEquipamento") AS "DescricaoEquipamento",
        IFNULL(OSB."SerieFabricante", TEQ."SerieFabricante") AS "SerieFabricante",

        IFNULL(
            IFNULL(OSB."CodigoCliente", TEQ."CodigoCliente"),
            IFNULL(TRF."CodigoClienteTransferencia", PVG."CodigoClientePedidoVenda")
        ) AS "CodigoCliente",

        IFNULL(
            IFNULL(OSB."NomeCliente", TEQ."NomeCliente"),
            IFNULL(TRF."NomeClienteTransferencia", PVG."NomeClientePedidoVenda")
        ) AS "NomeCliente",

        IFNULL(OSB."StatusCartao", TEQ."StatusCartao") AS "StatusCartao",
        IFNULL(OSB."HorimetroCartao", TEQ."HorimetroCartao") AS "HorimetroCartao",

        OSB."NumeroOS",
        OSB."DocumentoOS",
        OSB."DataCriacaoOS",
        OSB."DataFechamentoOS",

        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN LENGTH(IFNULL(OSB."AssuntoOS", '')) > 120
                THEN SUBSTRING(OSB."AssuntoOS", 1, 120) || '...'
                ELSE IFNULL(OSB."AssuntoOS", '')
            END
            AS NVARCHAR(123)
        ) AS "AssuntoOS",

        OSB."StatusOS",

        CASE
            WHEN IFNULL(OSB."CentroCustoOS", '') <> ''
            THEN OSB."CentroCustoOS"

            WHEN IFNULL(TRF."CentroCustoTransferencia", '') <> ''
            THEN TRF."CentroCustoTransferencia"

            ELSE ''
        END AS "CentroCustoOS",

        TRF."DocEntryTransferenciaRef",
        IFNULL(TRF."PedidosTransferencia", '') AS "PedidosTransferencia",
        TRF."UltimaDataTransferencia",
        IFNULL(TRF."ValorTransferenciaEstoque", 0) AS "ValorTransferenciaEstoque",
        IFNULL(TRF."MateriaisTransferencia", '') AS "MateriaisTransferencia",

        PVG."DocEntryPedidoVenda",
        PVG."PedidoVendaGeradoOS",
        PVG."DataPedidoVendaGeradoOS",
        IFNULL(PVG."ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS", 0) AS "ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS",

        PVI."DocEntryPVGeradoIClassRef",
        IFNULL(PVI."PVsGeradosIClass", '') AS "PVsGeradosIClass",
        PVI."UltimaDataPVGeradoIClass",
        IFNULL(PVI."ItensPVGeradoIClass", '') AS "ItensPVGeradoIClass",
        IFNULL(PVI."QuantidadePVGeradoIClass", 0) AS "QuantidadePVGeradoIClass",
        IFNULL(PVI."ValorPVGeradoIClass", 0) AS "ValorPVGeradoIClass",

        (
            IFNULL(TRF."ValorTransferenciaEstoque", 0)
            +
            IFNULL(PVG."ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS", 0)
            +
            IFNULL(PVI."ValorPVGeradoIClass", 0)
        ) AS "CustoTotalOS"

    FROM OS_BASE OSB

    LEFT JOIN TRANSF_AGR TRF
        ON TRF."NumeroOS" = OSB."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN TRANSF_EQ_UNICO TEQ
        ON TEQ."NumeroOS" = OSB."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN PV_OS_UNICO PVG
        ON PVG."NumeroOS" = OSB."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN PV_ICLASS_AGR PVI
        ON PVI."NumeroOS" = OSB."NumeroOS"
)

SELECT
    CT_LINK."ContractID" AS "Numero Contrato LOC1",

    EQ_LINK."insID" AS "Numero Cartao Equipamento",
    ITEM_LINK."ItemCode" AS "Codigo Equipamento",
    ITEM_LINK."ItemName" AS "Descricao Equipamento",
    R."SerieFabricante" AS "Serie Fabricante",

    BP_LINK."CardCode" AS "Codigo Cliente",
    BP_LINK."CardName" AS "Nome Cliente",

    R."StatusCartao" AS "Status Cartao",
    R."HorimetroCartao" AS "Horimetro Cartao",

    OS_LINK."callID" AS "Numero OS",
    OS_LINK."DocNum" AS "Documento OS",
    R."DataCriacaoOS" AS "Data Criacao OS",
    R."DataFechamentoOS" AS "Data Fechamento OS",
    R."AssuntoOS" AS "Assunto OS",
    R."StatusOS" AS "Status OS",
    R."CentroCustoOS" AS "Centro Custo OS",

    TR_LINK."DocNum" AS "Pedido Transferencia Ref",
    R."PedidosTransferencia" AS "Pedidos Transferencia",
    R."UltimaDataTransferencia" AS "Ultima Data Transferencia",
    R."ValorTransferenciaEstoque" AS "Valor Transferencia Estoque",
    R."MateriaisTransferencia" AS "Materiais Transferencia",

    PV_LINK."DocNum" AS "Pedido Venda Gerado OS",
    R."DataPedidoVendaGeradoOS" AS "Data Pedido Venda Gerado OS",
    R."ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS" AS "Valor Pedido Venda Gerado OS",

    PV_ICLASS_LINK."DocNum" AS "PV Gerado por iClass Ref",
    R."PVsGeradosIClass" AS "PVs Gerados por iClass",
    R."UltimaDataPVGeradoIClass" AS "Ultima Data PV Gerado por iClass",
    R."ItensPVGeradoIClass" AS "Itens PV Gerado por iClass",
    R."QuantidadePVGeradoIClass" AS "Quantidade Minutos PV Gerado por iClass",
    R."ValorPVGeradoIClass" AS "Valor PV Gerado por iClass",

    R."CustoTotalOS" AS "Custo Total OS",

    CASE
        WHEN R."ValorTransferenciaEstoque" = 0
         AND R."ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS" = 0
         AND R."ValorPVGeradoIClass" = 0
        THEN 'Sem custo vinculado'

        WHEN R."ValorTransferenciaEstoque" > 0
         AND R."ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS" > 0
         AND R."ValorPVGeradoIClass" > 0
        THEN 'Custo por transferencia, pedido gerado por OS e PV gerado por iClass'

        WHEN R."ValorTransferenciaEstoque" > 0
         AND R."ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS" > 0
        THEN 'Custo por transferencia e pedido gerado por OS'

        WHEN R."ValorTransferenciaEstoque" > 0
         AND R."ValorPVGeradoIClass" > 0
        THEN 'Custo por transferencia e PV gerado por iClass'

        WHEN R."ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS" > 0
         AND R."ValorPVGeradoIClass" > 0
        THEN 'Custo por pedido gerado por OS e PV gerado por iClass'

        WHEN R."ValorTransferenciaEstoque" > 0
        THEN 'Custo por transferencia de estoque'

        WHEN R."ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS" > 0
        THEN 'Custo por pedido de venda gerado por OS'

        WHEN R."ValorPVGeradoIClass" > 0
        THEN 'Custo por PV gerado por iClass'

        ELSE 'Validar'
    END AS "Origem Custo OS"

FROM RELATORIO R

LEFT JOIN OCTR CT_LINK
    ON CT_LINK."ContractID" = R."NumeroContratoLOC1"

LEFT JOIN OINS EQ_LINK
    ON EQ_LINK."insID" = R."NumeroCartaoEquipamento"

LEFT JOIN OITM ITEM_LINK
    ON ITEM_LINK."ItemCode" = R."CodigoEquipamento"

LEFT JOIN OCRD BP_LINK
    ON BP_LINK."CardCode" = R."CodigoCliente"

LEFT JOIN OSCL OS_LINK
    ON OS_LINK."callID" = R."NumeroOS"

LEFT JOIN OWTQ TR_LINK
    ON TR_LINK."DocEntry" = R."DocEntryTransferenciaRef"

LEFT JOIN ORDR PV_LINK
    ON PV_LINK."DocEntry" = R."DocEntryPedidoVenda"

LEFT JOIN ORDR PV_ICLASS_LINK
    ON PV_ICLASS_LINK."DocEntry" = R."DocEntryPVGeradoIClassRef"

ORDER BY
    BP_LINK."CardName",
    ITEM_LINK."ItemCode",
    EQ_LINK."insID",
    OS_LINK."callID";
```

A mudança principal foi tirar a busca por texto/campo do pedido e usar a aba de documentos relacionados via `SCL4`. Agora a OS 4306, por exemplo, deve encontrar o PV 5654 e trazer o item `SV000045`.

## Mensagem 680 | assistant | 09/04/2026 19:00:48

Perfeito. Vamos tratar assim:

`Quantidade em minutos / 60 * R$ 35,00`

E no `Custo Total OS`, o correto é somar o custo calculado de hora homem, não o valor do pedido de venda iClass.

Substitua estes blocos na query.

Bloco `PV_ICLASS_VALOR_AGR`:

```sql
PV_ICLASS_VALOR_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        B."NumeroOS",

        SUM(B."QuantidadeIClass") AS "QuantidadePVGeradoIClass",

        ROUND(
            SUM(B."QuantidadeIClass") / 60.0,
            2
        ) AS "HorasPVGeradoIClass",

        ROUND(
            (SUM(B."QuantidadeIClass") / 60.0) * 35.00,
            2
        ) AS "CustoHoraHomemPVGeradoIClass",

        SUM(B."ValorLinhaIClass") AS "ValorPVGeradoIClass"

    FROM PV_ICLASS_BASE B

    GROUP BY
        B."NumeroOS"
),
```

No bloco `PV_ICLASS_AGR`, acrescente estas duas colunas:

```sql
IFNULL(VAL."HorasPVGeradoIClass", 0) AS "HorasPVGeradoIClass",
IFNULL(VAL."CustoHoraHomemPVGeradoIClass", 0) AS "CustoHoraHomemPVGeradoIClass",
```

Ficando assim nessa parte:

```sql
PV_ICLASS_AGR AS (
    SELECT
        DOC."NumeroOS",
        REF."DocEntryPVGeradoIClass" AS "DocEntryPVGeradoIClassRef",
        DOC."PVsGeradosIClass",
        DOC."UltimaDataPVGeradoIClass",
        IFNULL(IT."ItensPVGeradoIClass", '') AS "ItensPVGeradoIClass",
        IFNULL(VAL."QuantidadePVGeradoIClass", 0) AS "QuantidadePVGeradoIClass",
        IFNULL(VAL."HorasPVGeradoIClass", 0) AS "HorasPVGeradoIClass",
        IFNULL(VAL."CustoHoraHomemPVGeradoIClass", 0) AS "CustoHoraHomemPVGeradoIClass",
        IFNULL(VAL."ValorPVGeradoIClass", 0) AS "ValorPVGeradoIClass"

    FROM PV_ICLASS_DOC_AGR DOC

    LEFT JOIN PV_ICLASS_DOC_REF REF
        ON REF."NumeroOS" = DOC."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN PV_ICLASS_ITEM_AGR IT
        ON IT."NumeroOS" = DOC."NumeroOS"

    LEFT JOIN PV_ICLASS_VALOR_AGR VAL
        ON VAL."NumeroOS" = DOC."NumeroOS"
),
```

No bloco `RELATORIO`, depois da quantidade do iClass, acrescente:

```sql
IFNULL(PVI."HorasPVGeradoIClass", 0) AS "HorasPVGeradoIClass",
IFNULL(PVI."CustoHoraHomemPVGeradoIClass", 0) AS "CustoHoraHomemPVGeradoIClass",
```

E altere o `CustoTotalOS` para este:

```sql
(
    IFNULL(TRF."ValorTransferenciaEstoque", 0)
    +
    IFNULL(PVG."ValorPedidoVendaGeradoOS", 0)
    +
    IFNULL(PVI."CustoHoraHomemPVGeradoIClass", 0)
) AS "CustoTotalOS"
```

No `SELECT` final, depois da coluna:

```sql
R."QuantidadePVGeradoIClass" AS "Quantidade Minutos PV Gerado por iClass",
```

adicione:

```sql
R."HorasPVGeradoIClass" AS "Horas PV Gerado por iClass",
R."CustoHoraHomemPVGeradoIClass" AS "Custo Hora Homem PV Gerado por iClass",
```

E nas regras de origem de custo, troque as validações de:

```sql
R."ValorPVGeradoIClass"
```

por:

```sql
R."CustoHoraHomemPVGeradoIClass"
```

Assim o relatório continua trazendo o PV iClass, os itens `SV000045` / `SV000044`, a quantidade em minutos, mas passa a calcular o custo real de hora homem com base em R$ 35,00/hora.
